title: Bảy Ngày Sinh Tồn (Seven Days in the Stone Age)
style: Photorealistic live-action survival adventure film with warm humor, set in the limestone jungles of northern Vietnam today and more than ten thousand years ago; lush natural greens, wet limestone greys, ember-orange firelight, natural skin texture with sweat and dirt, subtle 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field, grounded handheld energy.
lighting: Natural motivated light: clear green-gold afternoon sun through the jungle canopy and warm lamp light in the present day; misty dawn light, dappled midday sun, warm ember firelight inside the cave and cool blue storm light with white lightning flashes in the Stone Age; shadows stay soft, never murky.
voice_common: everyone speaks clear, natural English with a neutral international accent, says each word once and clearly, and keeps one consistent voice that is clearly different from every other character in pitch, age and texture.

@Khang.name: Khang
@Khang.anchor: Khang, 29, Vietnamese survival YouTuber; lean athletic build, tanned skin, short black undercut hair, light stubble, expressive dark eyes, a quick showman's grin; olive-green tactical shirt with a plain patch without letters, khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, a bright orange backpack.
@Khang.voice: man of 29, bright energetic tenor, a showman's voice that drops low and honest when serious

@Bin.name: Bin
@Bin.anchor: Bin, 24, Khang's cameraman and channel manager; slim, round face, round black-rimmed glasses, short messy black hair; cream bucket hat, thin yellow windbreaker over a black T-shirt, black jeans, white sneakers, a handheld camera gimbal.
@Bin.voice: young man of 24, light dry voice, deadpan and teasing

@Stream.name: Stream
@Stream.anchor: Stream, 19, Stone Age forager girl of the cave clan; slim and agile, warm brown skin, long straight black hair tied back with a vine cord, bright alert dark eyes, two thin red-ochre stripes on each cheekbone; a knee-length tunic of beaten tan bark cloth with a soft deer-hide wrap covering both shoulders, a necklace of small stream-snail shells, a woven rattan basket on her back, barefoot.
@Stream.voice: young woman of 19, clear warm alto, direct and curious

@Moon.name: Grandma Moon
@Moon.anchor: Grandma Moon, 65, Stone Age clan leader and keeper of the fire; small and straight-backed, deeply lined brown face, calm piercing eyes, white hair in a high knot held by a bone pin, a red-ochre dot on her forehead; a long dark hide cloak over a knee-length bark-cloth tunic, a thick green bamboo tube for carrying embers, barefoot.
@Moon.voice: old woman of 65, low slow husky voice with weight in every word

@Roar.name: Roar
@Roar.anchor: Roar, 30, the clan's strongest Stone Age hunter; tall, broad-shouldered and muscular, weathered brown skin, thick black hair bound with a strip of bark, heavy brows, a fierce jaw; a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, a long bamboo spear with a chipped stone tip, barefoot.
@Roar.voice: man of 30, deep rough bass, gruff and forceful

@Snail.name: Snail
@Snail.anchor: Snail, 8, Stream's little brother in the Stone Age clan; small and wiry, round cheeky face, big curious dark eyes, head shaved except a small tuft of hair on top; a small knee-length bark-cloth tunic covering both shoulders, a string of snail shells around one wrist, barefoot.
@Snail.voice: boy of 8, high bright child's voice, quick and excited

scenes.title: Five-Star Survival (Sinh tồn năm sao)
scenes.time_label: Chiều, rừng Cúc Phương ngày nay (00:00–01:00)
scenes.location: Rừng nguyên sinh Cúc Phương hôm nay: cây chò cổ thụ, rễ bạnh vè, dây leo, nắng chiều xiên qua tán lá. Cách máy quay hai chục mét là con đường nhựa cho xe điện chở khách du lịch.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đứng phía trong rừng nhìn ra con đường nhựa: gốc chò cổ thụ rễ bạnh vè ở giữa khung, Khang quỳ bên trái gốc cây, Bin cầm gimbal đứng bên phải, con đường nhựa thấp thoáng qua kẽ lá ở xa sau lưng Khang.
scenes.props: Gimbal cầm tay và mũ tai bèo của Bin, con sâu béo và túi kẹo dẻo rỗng, que gỗ xoay lửa và đống bùi nhùi, bật lửa của Bin, điện thoại màn hình chỉ phát sáng, camera đeo ngực của Khang, ba lô cam, xe điện chở khách trên đường nhựa.
scenes.setting: Cúc Phương primeval forest in northern Vietnam today, late afternoon: giant old trees with huge buttress roots, thick lianas, ferns and mossy limestone boulders, green-gold sunlight slanting through the canopy, a narrow paved visitor road glimpsed through the leaves.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Day three. No food, no clean water. I have no choice, I have to eat this worm to survive!
turns.tone: theatrical suffering, hamming it up for the lens

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Cut! Khang, we're out of gummy worms. That one's real.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Real? Forget it. Fire scene first.
turns.tone: grossed out, tossing the worm away

clips.sfx: insects buzzing and birdsong in the canopy, distant gibbon calls, dry leaves crunching under knees, the crinkle of an empty plastic candy bag, the soft whir of a gimbal motor

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the YouTuber kneeling at the giant buttress root with a fat worm held up to his chest camera, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the cameraman lowering his gimbal, locked off
40mm medium two-shot of both men at the buttress root, slight handheld drift

steps: @Khang kneels at the giant buttress root, pinches a fat wriggling worm between two fingers and is already speaking to his chest camera in a pained, theatrical voice.
@Khang keeps talking fast, scrunching his face in mock agony as he lifts the worm toward the little lens.
@Khang presses his free hand to his stomach and sways, still talking, eyes squeezed half shut.
@Khang tilts his head back and dangles the worm above his face while he keeps speaking.
@Khang raises the worm higher, voice trembling for effect, as the speech reaches its big finish.
@Khang finishes the line, closes his mouth and freezes with the worm just above his lips in a heroic pose.
@Bin lowers the gimbal from his eye and starts speaking in a flat, unbothered voice, his face completely deadpan.
@Bin keeps talking as he holds up an empty, crumpled bag of gummy candy and shakes it once.
@Bin points one finger at the wriggling worm while he goes on, eyebrows never moving.
@Bin finishes the sentence and closes his mouth, staring over the top of his round glasses.
@Khang stares at the worm wriggling between his fingers and starts speaking fast, eyes wide, nose wrinkled.
@Khang tosses the worm away over his shoulder, still talking quickly and wiping his fingers on his cargo trousers.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and scrambles to his feet, waving @Bin toward a pile of dry sticks.
In extreme close-up the fat worm lands on a broad fern leaf and wriggles calmly in the green-gold light.
The worm inches along the fern leaf while two pairs of shoes walk away across the leaf litter in soft focus behind it.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Friction, friction, patience makes fire! There's smoke! I can survive anywhere!
turns.tone: showman bravado, playing to the lens

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: That's my lighter. Three years, I've lit every fire for you. You've never made one yourself.
turns.tone: bored and flat, stating the obvious

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Keep your voice down! The mic picks up everything.

clips.sfx: a wooden drill whirring against a board, the click and hiss of a pocket lighter, crackling tinder catching, birdsong and insects in the canopy, leaves rustling

shots.camera: 24mm wide shot of the YouTuber spinning a wooden drill over a pile of tinder while the cameraman crouches hidden behind the buttress root at frame right, locked off
85mm close-up of the cameraman stepping out from behind the root with a lighter, slow push-in
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the YouTuber onto the cameraman, locked off
40mm medium two-shot of the YouTuber hissing at the cameraman beside the smoking tinder, handheld

steps: @Khang kneels over a pile of dry tinder, spinning a wooden drill between his palms like a kung fu star, and is already speaking loudly to his chest camera.
Behind the buttress root @Bin, crouched out of the YouTuber's view, reaches round and touches a small lighter flame to the tinder while @Khang keeps talking.
A curl of white smoke rises from the tinder; @Khang keeps spinning and talking faster, eyes wide in staged amazement.
@Khang springs to his feet with both fists raised high, finishes his triumphant line and closes his mouth in a frozen victory pose.
@Bin steps out from behind the root holding up the lighter and starts speaking in a bored, flat voice.
@Bin keeps talking as he flicks the lighter once, a small steady flame standing up in front of his round glasses.
@Bin lets the flame go out and goes on in the same flat tone, tilting his head toward the smoking pile.
@Bin keeps speaking, holding up three fingers of his free hand, face expressionless.
@Bin lowers the hand and keeps talking, eyes fixed on @Khang over the rims of his glasses.
@Bin finishes the last words with a tiny shrug and closes his mouth.
@Khang darts to @Bin's side, cups one hand over the little camera on his own chest and starts whispering sharply.
@Khang keeps whispering fast through his teeth, eyes darting left and right, hand pressed over the lens.
@Khang jabs a finger toward the small microphone on his harness, still whispering urgently into @Bin's face.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and glares at @Bin, nostrils flaring, while @Bin blinks back, mouth closed.
Beside them the tinder keeps smoking on the forest floor as @Bin slips the lighter into his yellow windbreaker pocket, both mouths closed.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Khang, the tourist shuttle drove behind you. Third time. They waved.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: So cut it! Make it look like deep jungle. Add monkey howls, add some fog.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Sure. So, tonight at the guesthouse, goat hotpot or hill chicken?
turns.tone: dry, with a thin teasing smile

clips.sfx: the soft electric whine and rolling tires of a passing open shuttle on asphalt, birdsong and cicadas, leaves rustling, boots shuffling on dry leaves
clips.extras: a few cheerful tourists in sun hats riding a white open-sided electric shuttle along the paved road, small and far behind the leaves in soft focus, waving

shots.camera: 40mm medium two-shot of both men by the buttress root with the gap in the leaves and the paved road behind the YouTuber, locked off
24mm wide shot of the YouTuber spreading his arms across the gap in the leaves as the shuttle rolls past behind him, handheld
85mm close-up of the cameraman behind his gimbal, slow push-in

steps: @Bin, gimbal in one hand, is already speaking in a flat voice and lifts his other hand to point past @Khang's shoulder.
@Bin keeps talking evenly while, through the leaves behind @Khang, a white open-sided electric shuttle glides along the paved road.
The tourists on the shuttle wave cheerfully toward the men as @Bin goes on, his pointing finger never moving.
@Bin finishes, closes his mouth and lowers his hand, while @Khang's eyes go wide.
@Khang glances back at the road, whips round to face the gimbal again and starts speaking fast, flapping one hand.
@Khang steps sideways into the gap in the leaves and spreads both arms wide to hide the shuttle, still talking quickly.
@Khang keeps talking, bobbing left and right to keep his body between the gimbal and the rolling shuttle.
@Khang waggles his fingers in the air like drifting fog while he keeps speaking.
@Khang flaps both hands up toward the canopy, still talking, eyebrows raised high.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and stays frozen with his arms spread across the gap, panting.
@Bin regards him over the gimbal and answers slowly with a thin, dry smile.
@Bin keeps talking slowly, tilting his head, the brim of his bucket hat shading his round glasses.
@Bin lets a small pause hang, then goes on in the same lazy, teasing voice.
@Bin keeps speaking slowly, lifting the gimbal back up toward his eye.
@Bin finishes, closes his mouth and waits behind the gimbal with the same thin smile.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: This comment: five-star survival, sleeps in a guesthouse, eats goat hotpot. Ten thousand likes.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Keyboard warriors. One night out here and they'd cry for mommy.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Have you ever spent one real night in the jungle?

clips.sfx: cicadas and birdsong in the late afternoon canopy, a thumb tapping a phone screen, leaves shifting underfoot, a soft breeze in the ferns

shots.camera: 85mm close-up of the cameraman reading from his glowing phone, locked off
50mm medium shot of the YouTuber glancing at the phone and folding his arms, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the YouTuber rolling his eyes, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the YouTuber onto the cameraman, locked off

steps: @Bin swipes his phone with a thumb, its screen only a soft glow, and is already speaking fast as if reading aloud.
@Bin keeps reading quickly, eyes flicking across the glowing screen, completely deadpan.
@Bin turns the glowing phone toward @Khang without looking up, still talking.
@Bin keeps talking briskly, tapping the glowing screen with one finger, the gimbal hanging from his other hand.
@Bin finishes the last words, closes his mouth and holds the phone out at arm's length.
@Khang glances at the glowing screen for a single second, curls his lip and starts speaking in a lazy, scornful voice.
@Khang folds his arms across his chest harness, still talking, chin lifted.
@Khang tilts his head back as he keeps speaking, a lopsided smirk on his face.
@Khang rolls his eyes up toward the canopy and goes on, giving a little dismissive snort.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and keeps his arms folded over the chest harness, smirking.
@Bin slowly lowers the phone and answers slowly, looking straight at @Khang.
@Bin keeps speaking quietly and evenly, his eyes steady behind the round glasses.
@Bin keeps talking slowly, not blinking behind his round glasses, letting each word land.
@Bin finishes the question, closes his mouth and waits in silence, the phone hanging at his side.
In the foreground @Khang's folded arms slowly loosen and his head tilts, the smirk gone, mouth closed.

scenes.title: Busted (Bị bóc phốt)
scenes.location: Phòng nhà sàn gỗ của một nhà nghỉ ven rừng, tối: đèn vàng, nồi lẩu dê sôi trên bếp ga mini, ngoài cửa sổ chớp loé không tiếng trên dãy núi đá vôi.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt ở góc trong phòng nhìn ra cửa sổ: bàn gỗ thấp với nồi lẩu ở giữa, Khang ngồi bên trái bàn, Bin ngồi bên phải, cửa sổ có chớp loé ở xa phía sau, cửa ra hiên nhà sàn ở mép phải khung hình.
scenes.props: Nồi lẩu dê sôi trên bếp ga mini, đũa gỗ và bát, điện thoại của Bin màn hình chỉ phát sáng, dao đa năng màu đỏ đeo thắt lưng Khang, đai camera đeo ngực, ba lô cam, đèn vàng.
scenes.setting: Night inside a wooden stilt-house guesthouse room at the edge of the forest: warm yellow lamp light, woven bamboo walls, a low wooden table with a small hotpot bubbling on a portable gas stove, a window where silent lightning flickers over dark limestone peaks.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Khang, someone filmed you ordering pizza delivery into the jungle. Two million views already!
turns.tone: fast and gleeful, rubbing it in

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Who filmed it? That night it was just you, me, and the delivery guy!

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: The delivery guy is subscribed to your channel.

clips.sfx: hotpot broth bubbling on a portable gas stove, the low hiss of the burner, chopsticks clattering on wood, rain pattering on the roof, distant rolling thunder

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot across the low table with the hotpot steaming between them, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the YouTuber sputtering over the hotpot, handheld
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the YouTuber onto the cameraman, locked off

steps: @Bin leans across the low table and is already speaking fast, pushing his glowing phone right up to @Khang's face.
@Khang freezes with his chopsticks halfway to his mouth, a strip of goat meat dangling, while @Bin keeps talking.
@Bin keeps talking quickly, waggling the glowing phone a hand's width from @Khang's nose.
@Bin taps the glowing screen twice, eyebrows high, still speaking with a gleeful grin.
@Bin finishes and closes his mouth as @Khang sputters and coughs on the hot broth, eyes watering.
@Khang drops his chopsticks on the table with a clatter and starts speaking fast in a hoarse voice.
@Khang keeps talking hoarsely, thumping his own chest with the flat of his hand, eyes streaming.
@Khang points across the table, then at himself, still talking fast, cheeks flushed from the broth.
@Khang counts on three fingers as he keeps talking, leaning forward over the steaming pot.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and stares, breathing hard through his nose.
@Bin sets the glowing phone face down on the table and answers slowly, totally deadpan.
@Bin keeps speaking slowly, picking up his own chopsticks and lifting a piece of meat from the pot.
@Bin finishes the sentence with a tiny shrug, closes his mouth and starts to chew.
@Khang slumps back against the woven bamboo wall and stares at the ceiling, mouth closed, while @Bin chews calmly.
Silent lightning flickers in the window behind them as the hotpot keeps bubbling, both men silent, mouths closed.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: The multitool brand just texted. They're canceling the sponsorship and want the deposit back.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Canceling? Three years I've promoted their multitools! They cut anything!

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: You only cut sandwiches and shoelaces. Three million subscribers know it now.

clips.sfx: a phone buzzing on a wooden table, hotpot bubbling, a floor cushion scraping as someone stands, rain on the roof, distant thunder

shots.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the YouTuber onto the cameraman reading his buzzing phone, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the YouTuber shooting up to his feet with his multitool, handheld tilt up
40mm medium two-shot across the low table, the YouTuber standing and the cameraman seated, slow push-in

steps: @Bin's phone buzzes on the table; he picks it up, its screen only a soft glow, and is already speaking in an even voice as he reads.
@Bin keeps talking, eyes moving across the glowing screen, his face sagging little by little.
@Bin pushes his round glasses up his nose with one finger, still reading aloud evenly.
@Bin keeps speaking, lips pressed thin between phrases, his shoulders dropping inside the yellow windbreaker.
@Bin lowers the phone and looks up over his glasses, finishing the last words.
@Bin closes his mouth and sets the glowing phone down beside the hotpot.
@Khang shoots up to his feet, knocking the table edge with his knee, and starts speaking fast, voice cracking.
@Khang pulls the red folding multitool from his belt pouch and holds it up beside his face, still talking fast.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and shakes the multitool in the air, chest heaving.
@Bin looks up at him from his floor cushion and answers slowly, without a trace of a smile.
@Bin keeps speaking slowly, miming a tiny sawing motion with two fingers as if cutting a sandwich.
@Bin goes on in the same flat voice, picking up the glowing phone again.
@Bin keeps talking slowly, turning the glowing phone toward @Khang like evidence.
@Bin keeps speaking slowly, a hint of pity in his raised eyebrows above the round glasses.
@Bin finishes, closes his mouth and sets the phone down, while @Khang's hand with the multitool slowly sinks.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Fine. Tonight I sleep alone in the Cave of Hands. Real footage. No cuts.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: There's a storm coming! The cave is closed! You'd risk your life for views?

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Wait at the ranger station. Six a.m.

clips.sfx: rain drumming on the roof, thunder rolling over the mountains, the click of a plastic buckle, nylon straps tightening, a wooden floor creaking under quick steps

shots.camera: 40mm medium two-shot of the YouTuber buckling on his chest harness by the table as lightning flickers in the window, slow push-in
24mm wide shot of the cameraman spreading his arms across the doorway, handheld
85mm close-up of the YouTuber's steady face, locked off
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the YouTuber onto the cameraman in the doorway, locked off

steps: @Khang looks at the silent lightning flickering in the window and is already speaking, fast and determined, jaw set.
@Khang picks the black chest harness up from the table and lifts it over his head, still talking.
@Khang settles the small camera at the center of his chest, still speaking quickly.
@Khang snaps the harness buckle shut with a loud click, eyes fixed ahead as he talks.
@Khang tugs the strap tight, finishes his words and closes his mouth.
@Bin darts to the doorway, plants himself in it with both arms spread across the frame and starts speaking fast.
@Bin keeps talking urgently, nodding out toward the flickering storm without leaving the doorway.
@Bin shakes his head hard, glasses slipping, still talking fast with his arms spread.
@Bin keeps speaking, voice rising, bucket hat askew, palms flat on both sides of the door frame.
@Bin finishes the question and closes his mouth, still blocking the doorway, breathing hard.
@Khang looks at him calmly and answers at an even pace, eyes steady.
@Khang keeps speaking evenly, tapping the camera on his chest once with two fingers.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and gives a single firm nod, lightning glinting on the little camera lens.
Over @Khang's shoulder @Bin stays in the doorway, slowly lowering his arms, mouth closed.
@Khang steps toward the door as white lightning flickers across the window, both men silent, mouths closed.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Villagers say a god once stepped out of the lightning, taught the cave people fire, then left with the thunder.
turns.tone: low and spooky, telling a ghost story

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Nice. Tonight I'll be that god.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: A god who needs me to light his fires?

clips.sfx: heavy rain on the roof, the hiss of the gas stove, wooden floorboards creaking under boots, wind gusting through the open door, a loud crack of thunder with the lightning flash

steps: @Bin holds his glowing phone under his chin so the light hits his face from below and is already speaking in a low, spooky voice.
@Bin keeps talking slowly and mysteriously, widening his eyes behind the round glasses.
@Bin raises his free hand and wiggles his fingers like falling rain as he goes on.
@Bin leans closer, still speaking in a hushed storyteller's voice, the light trembling on his face.
@Bin keeps telling the tale, eyes darting toward the window and back.
@Bin spreads his hand slowly in the air as if a flash of lightning were opening, still speaking low.
@Bin keeps talking, his eyebrows climbing as the tale reaches its end.

scenes.title: The Cave of Hands (Đêm giông trong hang Bàn Tay)
scenes.location: Hang đá vôi xuyên núi trong rừng Cúc Phương ngày nay: cửa hang rộng, một nhũ đá to hình con voi, nền đất khô, vách đá phủ hàng trăm dấu bàn tay đỏ son đã mờ. Ngoài cửa hang mưa như trút, chớp trắng loá.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đứng sâu trong lòng hang nhìn ra cửa hang: cửa hang mưa trắng xoá ở xa, nhũ đá hình con voi treo bên trái, vách đá phủ bàn tay đỏ ở bên phải, Khang ngồi giữa nền đất; riêng 03.4 máy quay đứng trên bãi cát nhìn dọc dòng suối, vách đá vôi bên trái, suối chảy bên phải.
scenes.props: Đèn pin đội đầu, camera hành trình cầm tay và đai đeo ngực, ba lô cam, vách đá với hàng trăm bàn tay đỏ son và bàn tay to nhất ở giữa; ở 03.4 là bãi cát ướt, đá cuội, ba lô cam nằm cạnh Khang và đèn đỏ của camera.
scenes.setting: Night inside a large limestone cave today during a raging storm: a wide arched mouth, a huge stalactite shaped like an elephant, a dry earthen floor, a rock wall covered with hundreds of faded red-ochre hand stencils with one bigger hand in the middle and a slightly smaller hand beside it, sheets of rain and white lightning beyond the entrance, light only from a headlamp.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Eleven p.m., in the Cave of Hands. Nobody with me. Nobody lighting my fires. That rain is real.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: So if you think I fake it, watch closely. This time it's one hundred percent real.
turns.tone: intense, eyes locked on the lens

clips.sfx: heavy rain roaring at the cave mouth, water dripping from the stalactite, wind moaning through the cave, a deep roll of thunder after a lightning flash

turns.speaker: @Khang

turns.speaker: @Khang

steps: @Khang walks slowly along the rock wall, the headlamp beam sliding over rows of faded red handprints, and is already speaking softly in awe.

@Khang steps back to take in the whole wall and starts speaking again at an easy pace, half grinning to his chest camera.
@Khang keeps talking, nodding up at the big red hand in the middle of the wall.

steps: A deep boom of thunder shakes the cave; @Khang, palm still on the wall, is already shouting fast, eyes darting up to the ceiling.

@Khang keeps talking fast, the headlamp beam jerking across the trembling rock as he looks around.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and tries to pull his hand off the wall, but it does not move.
@Khang tugs his arm back hard and starts shouting fast again, his palm stuck flat on the big red hand.
@Khang braces his other hand and one boot against the wall and pulls, still talking fast through clenched teeth.

turns.speaker: @Khang

turns.speaker: @Khang

steps: @Khang walks along the sandy bank holding his phone high above his head, its screen only a soft glow, and is already speaking in a puzzled voice.
@Khang keeps talking, waving the glowing phone left and right in search of a signal.
@Khang climbs onto a smooth river stone and stretches the phone higher, still speaking.
@Khang lowers the glowing phone, frowns at it and keeps talking, glancing up and down the empty bank.
@Khang stares at the glowing screen, jaw tight, as he goes on at an even pace.
@Khang points toward the far bend of the stream where a road should be, finishing his words.
@Khang closes his mouth, slips the phone into a pocket and takes a long breath.
@Khang forces a big grin, starts talking fast and turns in a slow circle so his chest camera sweeps the giant trees.

@Khang knocks on the enormous trunk with his knuckles, still talking fast, eyebrows raised.
@Khang spreads his arms toward the forest and keeps talking, his voice getting louder.
@Khang raises one hand beside his face and keeps calling out quickly toward the trees.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: This footprint... it's as big as a dinner tray. Three round toes. That's something heavy.

turns.speaker: @Khang

turns.speaker: @Khang

@Khang touches each of the three round toe marks in turn as he goes on.

turns.speaker: @Khang

steps: @Khang lies flat on his belly behind a mossy boulder, parting the reeds with two fingers, and is already whispering slowly to his chest camera.

@Khang keeps whispering slowly, eyes huge, not blinking as he watches the rhino's folded skin shift.
@Khang keeps whispering, inching higher behind the boulder for a better look.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth for a breath, then starts whispering again, faster and urgent.
@Khang keeps whispering fast, shaking his head in disbelief, sweat beading on his upper lip.
@Khang keeps whispering quickly, pointing one finger back over the boulder toward the far bank.
@Khang keeps whispering, a wild disbelieving grin twitching at the corners of his mouth.
@Khang presses his palm flat to the boulder and keeps whispering fast.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth, and across the stream the rhino lifts its dripping head from the water.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: No roads. No trash. Not one motorbike engine.

scenes.title: Day One: Water and Fire (Ngày 1: Nước và lửa)
scenes.location: Rừng già ven suối buổi trưa: dây leo to bằng cổ tay, bụi tre, chuối rừng, đá phủ rêu, nắng loang trên lá.

turns.speaker: @Khang

@Khang keeps speaking evenly, flexing his red blistered fingers in the air above his chest.
@Khang keeps talking as he lifts the camera a little higher, eyes wet and shining in the sunlight.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth for a moment, then starts speaking again with a small tired smile.
@Khang keeps talking evenly, letting out a soft breath of a laugh.
@Khang keeps speaking, rubbing his thumb over a blister, eyes on the lens.
@Khang keeps talking quietly, the crooked smile settling into something calmer and softer.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and lets the camera rest on his chest, staring up at the canopy.

scenes.title: The Boy on the Rock (Cậu bé trên tảng đá)
scenes.location: Khúc suối rộng có một tảng đá lớn giữa dòng; bờ bên kia là bìa rừng rậm; nắng chiều chói trên mặt nước.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt ở hạ lưu nhìn ngược dòng: bờ gần có bụi lau và Khang ở bên trái khung, tảng đá đỉnh phẳng giữa dòng ở giữa, bờ bên kia với bìa rừng và con hổ ở bên phải; Khang luôn nhìn sang phải, con hổ không bao giờ xuống nước.
scenes.props: Tấm chăn bạc giữ nhiệt, cái còi trên dây ở đai ngực, camera đeo ngực, tảng đá đỉnh phẳng giữa suối, vỏ ốc suối Snail giơ lên, chuỗi vỏ ốc trên cổ Stream, giáo tre mũi đá Stream cầm ngang thân rồi dựng đứng, giỏ mây sau lưng Stream.
scenes.setting: A wide jungle stream in the Stone Age in afternoon light: a big flat-topped boulder in the middle of the current, thick reeds on the near bank, a dense forest edge about twenty meters away on the far bank, sun glare on the water.

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: Help! Help! The tiger's been waiting for me since the sun was high!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Stay up there! Don't jump in the water! I'm thinking, don't be scared!

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: Stranger! It's looking at you now! It's going to cross!

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: rushing stream water, a low rumbling growl from the far bank, reeds thrashing as someone pushes through, quick panting breaths, cicadas

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the boy crouched on top of the flat boulder in the middle of the stream, shouting toward the near bank, handheld
85mm close-up of the YouTuber pushing out of the reeds on the near bank, panting, locked off
24mm wide shot down the stream with the boy on the boulder in the middle and the tiger pacing under the trees on the far bank, slow push-in

steps: @Snail crouches on top of the flat boulder in the middle of the stream, clutching the rock with both hands, and is already shouting fast toward the near bank.
@Snail keeps shouting, waving one small arm, his big eyes darting toward the far bank.
@Snail points a shaking finger across the water as he keeps shouting, the tuft of hair on his head bobbing.
@Snail keeps shouting the last words, hugging his knees in his small bark-cloth tunic, breathing in quick gasps.
@Khang pushes out through the tall reeds onto the near bank, chest heaving, and starts shouting fast toward the boulder.
@Khang keeps shouting, both palms raised toward the boy as if to hold him in place.
@Khang keeps talking fast, glancing across the stream toward the far bank, sweat on his face.
@Khang taps his own temple with two fingers, still talking quickly, eyes flicking around for an idea.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and swallows hard, staring across the water at the far bank.
@Snail on the boulder points across the stream and starts shouting fast again, while on the far bank a striped tiger paces under the trees.
@Snail keeps shouting, voice cracking, as the tiger stops pacing on the far bank and turns its head toward the near bank.
@Snail keeps shouting quickly, scrambling to the highest point of the boulder, as the tiger takes one slow step toward the edge of its own bank.
@Snail finishes and closes his mouth, frozen with his knees pulled up and both hands flat on the rock.
On the far bank the tiger stands at the edge of the water, head low, amber eyes fixed across the stream, tail swaying.
The tiger lowers its nose toward the water on its own side of the stream and stays there, ears forward, never stepping in.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Hey! Go away! Look at this! Shiny, huh? Big, huh? I'm bigger than you! Look big, make noise, never turn your back and run!
turns.tone: yelling and making himself big, then panting

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: The silver skin shines like the sun! The tiger's backing off!

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: a foil blanket crackling and snapping in the wind, the rushing stream, a low growl fading into the forest, a sharp whistle blowing in short bursts, a boy's delighted gasp

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the YouTuber at the edge of the reeds shaking open a crackling silver blanket, handheld
24mm wide shot down the stream with the YouTuber on the near bank holding the blazing silver blanket high, the boy on the boulder in the middle and the tiger on the far bank, locked off
85mm close-up of the boy on the boulder lit by the flashing silver light, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the YouTuber past the raised blanket toward the far bank, locked off

steps: @Khang pulls the folded silver blanket from his cargo pocket, shakes it open with a loud crackle and is already shouting fast across the stream.
@Khang hoists the silver blanket high over his head with both arms so it catches the sun and flares, still shouting.
@Khang waves the blazing silver sheet from side to side, shouting fast toward the far bank, eyes wide.
@Khang rises on his toes and spreads the blanket wider above him, still shouting, cords standing out in his neck.
@Khang finishes the shout and closes his mouth for a breath, the silver sheet flashing sunlight across the water.
@Khang starts shouting again fast, holding his ground on the near bank, never turning his back to the far bank.
Light from the blanket dances over the far bank as @Khang keeps shouting, and the tiger there stops and squints.
@Khang keeps shouting, stamping one boot at the edge of his own bank, then finishes and closes his mouth as the tiger takes a step back.
@Snail on the boulder stares at the flashing silver light, eyes huge, and starts crying out fast with delight.
@Snail keeps shouting excitedly, pointing at the far bank with one small hand.
@Snail bounces on his knees on the boulder, still shouting, a huge grin on his round face.
@Snail finishes, closes his mouth and claps both hands to his chest, beaming.
@Khang raises the whistle on its cord to his lips and blows sharp bursts, the blanket still held high.
Across the stream the tiger flattens its ears, turns away and slinks back between the trees of the far bank.
The tiger's striped tail vanishes into the forest; @Khang lowers the whistle and the blanket, chest heaving, mouth closed.

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: Silver skin! Shinier than water! Even the tiger's scared! Let me touch!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: It's not skin, it's a blanket. Twelve bucks online. Where do you live?

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: My name is like this! I live in the cave up there!
turns.tone: proud and bouncy, showing his shell

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: water sloshing around wading legs, a foil blanket crinkling, the stream rushing over the boulder, bare feet landing on wet sand, birds calling at the forest edge

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of the YouTuber wading knee-deep toward the near bank with the boy riding on his back, handheld follow
85mm close-up of the YouTuber's face with the boy's hand reaching past his cheek to the silver blanket, locked off
24mm wide shot of the two of them on the sandy near bank as the boy hops down, locked off
85mm close-up of the boy holding up a small stream-snail shell beside his grin, slow push-in

steps: @Khang wades knee-deep through the stream toward the near bank with @Snail riding on his back, and @Snail is already talking excitedly, patting the silver blanket over @Khang's shoulders.
@Snail keeps talking, rubbing a corner of the crinkling silver blanket between his fingers, eyes round.
@Snail holds the shiny corner up to the sun and keeps talking, the light flashing on his face.
@Snail leans over @Khang's shoulder to peer at his own reflection in the blanket, still talking.
@Snail finishes, closes his mouth and presses his cheek to the shiny blanket, grinning.
@Khang, still wading, glances back over his shoulder and starts answering evenly, a tired smile on his face.
@Khang keeps talking at an easy pace, gently tugging the blanket edge out of the small fingers.
@Khang keeps speaking, raising his eyebrows with a wry little shrug under the boy's weight.
@Khang steps up onto the sand and keeps talking, looking up at the boy on his back.
@Khang finishes the question, closes his mouth and crouches so @Snail can slide down.
@Snail hops down onto the sand and starts talking fast, fingering the string of shells on his wrist.
@Snail keeps talking fast, holding up a small spiral stream-snail shell right in front of @Khang's nose.
@Snail keeps talking quickly, tapping the shell and then his own chest, beaming.
@Snail points up toward the limestone cliff beyond the trees with the shell, still talking fast.
@Snail finishes, closes his mouth and grins up at @Khang with the shell held high.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Don't move! Away from my brother! Why is your skin green?

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Easy! I just saved him from a tiger! It's a shirt, not skin!

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: What is shirt? Come. Grandmother decides if you're man or ghost.
turns.tone: wary and curious, laying down terms

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: reeds rustling and parting, the stream rushing over the boulder, bare feet on wet sand, snail shells clicking on a necklace, birds calling at the forest edge

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the girl stepping out of the reeds with a bamboo spear held level across her body, handheld
85mm close-up of the YouTuber raising both hands, locked off
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the YouTuber onto the girl, slow push-in
24mm wide shot of the two on the sandy bank with the stream and the boulder behind them, locked off

steps: @Stream steps fast out of the tall reeds, a long bamboo spear with a chipped stone head held level across her body in both hands, and is already speaking sharply.
@Stream plants her bare feet on the sand, still speaking fast, the stream-snail necklace swinging on her chest.
@Stream keeps talking, eyes narrowing as they run down @Khang's olive-green shirt, the spear still held crosswise.
@Stream finishes the question, closes her mouth and holds her ground, jaw tight.
@Khang shoots both hands up, palms open, and starts talking fast, eyes flicking to the spear.
@Khang keeps talking quickly, jerking his head back toward the boulder in the stream.
@Khang keeps talking, pinching the front of his olive-green shirt between finger and thumb to show it.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and holds his hands high, breathing hard, a shaky half smile on his face.
@Stream tilts her head at the strange word, then starts speaking evenly, her eyes still wary.
@Stream keeps talking, lowering the spear a little but keeping it across her body.
@Stream jerks her chin toward the limestone cliff upstream as she keeps speaking.
@Stream keeps speaking evenly, studying @Khang's face as if deciding something, her grip easing on the spear.
@Stream finishes, closes her mouth and steps aside to let him pass, the spear now upright in one hand.
@Khang lowers his hands slowly and walks ahead of her along the sand, mouth closed, glancing back at the spear.
@Stream follows two paces behind with the spear held upright, mouth closed, the snail-shell necklace clicking against her chest.

scenes.title: The Cave With No Hands (Hang chưa có bàn tay)
scenes.location: Chính hang Bàn Tay hơn một vạn năm trước: cùng cửa hang rộng và nhũ đá hình con voi, nhưng vách đá trơn, chưa có dấu tay nào. Bếp lửa giữa hang, da thú phơi, giỏ mây đựng ốc, mười mấy người tiền sử mặc áo vỏ cây và da thú kín vai đến gối.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt trong lòng hang nhìn ra cửa hang: cửa hang vòm rộng và nhũ đá hình con voi ở xa nhất, bếp lửa ở giữa, vách đá trơn không dấu tay bên trái, giá phơi da thú và ổ lá khô bên phải; góc tối cuối hang nằm sau lưng máy quay.
scenes.props: Giáo tre mũi đá của Roar, ống tre xanh giữ lửa của Grandma Moon, bếp lửa giữa hang, nhũ đá hình con voi, vách đá trơn không dấu tay, giỏ mây đựng ốc, da thú phơi trên sào, ba lô cam và camera ngực có đèn đỏ của Khang.
scenes.setting: A large limestone cave more than ten thousand years ago at dusk, home of a small Stone Age clan: a wide arched mouth, a huge stalactite shaped like an elephant, bare rock walls with no handprints or drawings, a hearth fire in the middle, hides drying on poles, rattan baskets of snails, sleeping beds of dry leaves, a stream running below the entrance.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Stream! Why bring a stranger here? He smells strange. The tiger will follow!
turns.tone: harsh and suspicious, barking each word

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: The tiger already came. He chased it off and saved Snail. Where were you, Roar?

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Hunting, to feed the cave. What did he bring?

clips.sfx: evening cicadas rising from the jungle, the stream rushing below the cave mouth, the hearth fire crackling deep inside, bare feet scuffing on packed earth

shots.camera: 24mm wide shot of the cave mouth at dusk with @Roar planted in the entrance facing the lens, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Roar under the elephant-shaped stalactite, locked off
50mm medium shot of @Stream stepping up into the cave mouth, handheld follow
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Stream onto @Roar, slow push-in

steps: @Roar stands planted in the wide cave mouth with his bamboo spear held upright and is already shouting, harsh, chest pushed out.
@Roar keeps talking, flaring his nostrils and sniffing the air toward the jungle path as if catching a strange smell.
@Roar keeps shouting and jerks his chin toward the dark trees, his boar-tusk necklace swaying on the hide vest.
@Roar keeps speaking through clenched teeth, heavy brows drawn down, knuckles tight around the upright spear shaft.
@Roar finishes the warning, closes his mouth and breathes hard through his nose, blocking the entrance.
@Stream steps up from the path into the cave mouth and answers fast, chin raised, the rattan basket on her back.
@Stream keeps talking firmly and moves sideways to stand between @Roar and a blurred figure far down the path.
@Stream keeps speaking and points one hand back toward the stream below, her red-ochre stripes catching the last light.
@Stream keeps talking, eyes narrowing at @Roar, her bare feet planted wide on the earthen floor.
@Stream finishes with the pointed question, closes her mouth and holds his stare without blinking.
@Roar answers coldly with a tight mouth, lifting his gaze over the top of her head toward the path.
@Roar keeps talking in a flat low voice and thumps his free fist once against his own boar-hide vest.
@Roar keeps speaking, his eyes sliding past @Stream to study the blurred figure waiting on the path.
@Roar finishes the question, closes his mouth and sets his jaw, the spear still upright at his side.
@Stream stays in front of him with her arms at her sides, breathing steadily, both mouths closed in the fading dusk light.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Stranger. This cave does not feed strange mouths.
turns.tone: slow and grave, measuring every word

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Grandma, I don't need food. Just a safe place to sleep. I'll feed myself!
turns.tone: eager and fast, a little too polite

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Feed yourself? Good. Seven suns, by your own hands. Live, and you stay.
turns.tone: slow and final, like speaking a law

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: the hearth fire crackling and popping, rustling dry leaves and shuffling bare feet in the dark, wind sighing across the cave mouth, a hide creaking on its drying pole

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of @Moon seated by the hearth cradling the green bamboo ember tube, slow push-in
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Moon onto @Khang kneeling in the firelight, locked off
85mm close-up of @Moon's lined face in the firelight, locked off
35mm medium two-shot of @Moon and @Khang on either side of the hearth, slow pull-back

steps: @Moon sits by the hearth cradling a thick green bamboo ember tube in both hands and is already speaking, slow and grave.
@Moon keeps speaking slowly, her calm eyes travelling up @Khang from his muddy boots to his face.
@Moon keeps talking with weight in every word, the red-ochre dot on her forehead glowing in the firelight.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth as @Khang drops to his knees before her, the orange backpack still on his shoulders.
@Khang answers fast and eagerly, both palms raised, his face lit orange by the hearth.
@Khang keeps talking quickly, pressing one hand to his chest and shaking his head at the food baskets.
@Khang keeps speaking and gestures toward a bed of dry leaves against the bare rock wall.
@Khang keeps talking and taps his own chest with a showman's grin, nodding hard.
@Khang finishes the promise, closes his mouth and swallows, still kneeling, while @Moon watches with her mouth closed.
@Moon answers slowly with a faint lift of one eyebrow, her voice low and husky.
@Moon sets the ember tube across her knees and keeps speaking, slow and deliberate.
@Moon raises both open hands in front of her face, fingers spread, counting the suns as she speaks.
@Moon keeps speaking with weight in every word, her open hands held still between them in the firelight.
@Moon speaks the last words slowly and lowers her hands onto the ember tube as @Khang nods, mouth closed.
@Moon finishes, closes her mouth and holds his gaze, while @Khang breathes out slowly on his knees, mouth closed.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Wait... that elephant stalactite. This entrance. It's the Cave of Hands.
turns.tone: slow and stunned, half to himself

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Hands? The wall has only stone and smoke. You talk strange words.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: No hands yet. That means... I got here before the handprints.
turns.tone: a hushed whisper, piecing it together

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: the hearth fire crackling behind them, water dripping from the stalactite into a small pool, the stream rushing below the cave mouth, a palm sliding over dry rock

shots.camera: 24mm low-angle medium shot of @Khang with the elephant-shaped stalactite looming above him, slow push-in
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Khang at the bare wall onto @Stream, locked off
35mm medium two-shot of @Khang and @Stream at the bare rock wall, locked off
85mm close-up of @Khang's face beside his palm pressed flat on the bare rock, slow push-in

steps: @Khang stands frozen under the elephant-shaped stalactite, head tilted back, and is already speaking slowly, half to himself.
@Khang keeps talking in a low voice, his eyes tracing the long trunk-like curve of the stalactite.
@Khang turns slowly toward the wide arched mouth of the cave as he keeps speaking, breath held between words.
@Khang keeps speaking, one hand drifting up to the small camera on his chest harness without pressing it.
@Khang finishes the name of the cave, closes his mouth and walks straight toward the bare rock wall.
@Stream follows a step behind and asks, puzzled, head tilted, as @Khang lays his palm flat on the smooth stone.
@Stream keeps talking and sweeps one hand across the bare smoke-stained rock to show there is nothing on it.
@Stream keeps speaking with a small frown, the snail-shell necklace clicking softly on her chest.
@Stream keeps talking, eyes narrowing at his strange words, while @Khang stays silent with his mouth closed.
@Stream finishes, closes her mouth and folds her arms, waiting for an answer.
@Khang answers in a hushed whisper, sliding his palm slowly across the empty wall.
@Khang keeps whispering and spreads his fingers wide on the smooth stone exactly where a handprint should be.
@Khang keeps whispering, eyes wide and glistening in the firelight, his breath catching between words.
@Khang whispers the last words, his spread fingers trembling slightly against the bare rock.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and swallows hard, his palm still pressed to the cold wall in silence.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Everyone... I think this is the Stone Age. Over ten thousand years ago. Grandma gave me seven days. Seven-day survival. Like my video titles.
turns.tone: hushed whisper to the lens, then low and wry

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Only now, if I fail, nobody can cut it out.
turns.tone: slow and honest, the showman gone

clips.setting: Night inside the large Stone Age clan cave: the elephant-shaped stalactite, bare rock walls with no handprints, a hearth fire glowing red, sleeping beds of dry leaves, hides on poles, deep shadows beyond the firelight.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: the distant hearth crackling softly, slow breathing of sleepers in the dark, crickets and frogs outside the cave mouth, water dripping onto stone
clips.extras: a few clan members in bark-cloth tunics and hide wraps asleep around the distant glowing hearth, dark silhouettes in soft focus

shots.camera: 24mm close-up of @Khang's face as seen from the small camera he holds at arm's length, slight handheld wobble
50mm medium shot of @Khang hunched against the rock wall in the dark corner with the distant hearth behind him, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Khang's face in the faint red glow, locked off

steps: @Khang sits in the dark far corner of the cave holding the small chest camera at arm's length toward his face and is already whispering to it.
@Khang keeps whispering, glancing over his shoulder at the sleeping shapes around the distant hearth.
@Khang keeps talking low into the lens, eyebrows raised, the tiny red recording light glowing below his chin.
@Khang keeps whispering and shakes his head slowly, as if he cannot believe his own words.
@Khang finishes the thought, closes his mouth and lets out a long shaky breath in the dark.
@Khang shifts his back against the cold rock wall and starts speaking again with a tired half-smile.
@Khang keeps talking and traces a big frame in the air with his free hand, a flicker of the old showman in his eyes.
@Khang keeps speaking wryly and lets the hand drop onto his muddy knee.
@Khang keeps talking as his smile fades, his eyes going back to the small lens.
@Khang finishes the sentence, closes his mouth and lowers his eyes to the dirt floor.
@Khang lifts his eyes to the lens and speaks again, slowly and honestly, the showman gone from his face.
@Khang keeps speaking slowly, his jaw tight, the red light trembling slightly in his hand.
@Khang keeps speaking softly, swallowing between words, his eyes shining in the faint firelight.
@Khang says the last words slowly, staring straight into the small lens without blinking.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and keeps holding the camera in silence, breathing slowly in the dark corner.

scenes.title: Day Two: Food That Doesn't Run (Ngày 2: Đồ ăn không biết chạy)
scenes.location: Khe suối nông, đá cuội tròn, nước trong đến mắt cá chân; sau đó là bếp lửa trong hang buổi trưa.
scenes.axis: Ở khe suối máy quay đứng ở bờ cạn nhìn ngược dòng: tảng đá lớn nơi Stream ngồi bên trái, lòng suối nông đá cuội ở giữa, bìa rừng ở xa; trong hang máy quay đặt cạnh bếp lửa nhìn ra cửa hang sáng, Grandma Moon ngồi bên trái bếp, ổ lá khô bên phải.
scenes.props: Giỏ mây của Stream, những hòn đá dẹt bám đầy ốc suối, gói mì tôm vỏ vàng trơn không chữ sột soạt, vắt mì khô, gói gia vị nhỏ, ống tre giữ lửa của Grandma Moon, bếp lửa trong hang, camera ngực của Khang.
scenes.setting: A shallow rocky stretch of the jungle stream in the Stone Age, morning: round pebbles, clear ankle-deep water, flat stones covered with small dark snails, a big boulder on the bank, sunlight sparkling.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Day two. Starving. Fish, hold still... Ah! Slipped again! That's ten in a row!

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: You chased fish all morning. The fish are not tired. You are.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Then you catch one! Stop laughing, I'm about to faint.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: the shallow stream babbling over round pebbles, a big splash as a body hits the water, morning birdsong and cicadas in the jungle, water dripping from soaked clothes

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Khang bent over the ankle-deep water with his hands hovering, handheld follow
24mm wide shot of the sparkling shallows with @Khang facing the lens and @Stream on the boulder beside him, locked off
85mm close-up of @Stream on the boulder with her chin on her hand, locked off
35mm medium two-shot of @Khang sitting soaked in the shallows with @Stream on the boulder behind him, slow push-in

steps: @Khang crouches in the ankle-deep water with both hands hovering over a darting fish and is already talking fast to his chest camera.
@Khang keeps talking in a breathless rush, creeping one boot forward over the round wet pebbles.
@Khang plunges both hands into the water with a shout as the silver fish flicks away between his fingers.
@Khang's boot slides on a mossy pebble and he lands on his backside in a big splash, still talking.
@Khang finishes the complaint, closes his mouth and wipes stream water from his face, soaked to the chest.
@Stream sits on the big boulder on the bank, chin on one hand, and answers with a laugh in her voice.
@Stream keeps talking and points lazily at a fish gliding calmly around his muddy boots.
@Stream keeps speaking, her red-ochre striped cheeks lifting in a wide grin.
@Stream keeps talking, tilting her head at him as he drips, while @Khang listens with his mouth closed.
@Stream finishes, closes her mouth and presses her lips together to hold back another laugh.
@Khang flops both arms into the water and fires back in a whiny voice, pointing up at her.
@Khang keeps talking and flicks a handful of water toward her boulder with an exaggerated pout.
@Khang keeps speaking and slumps back on his hands in the shallow water, eyes rolling up to the sky.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and lets his head flop back dramatically, water streaming from his hair.
@Khang sits dripping in the sparkling stream with his mouth closed, while @Stream grins down at him in silence.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: No chasing. Lift the stones, find snails. Snails don't run. Good for you.

turns.speaker: @Khang

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: What is angel? Roast snails first. Raw ones hurt your belly.

@Khang lurches up onto his knees in the water and bursts out talking, eyes fixed on the snails.

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: I fell asleep! Rain blew in, the fire's dead! The tube is cold, Grandma!
turns.tone: crying hard, the words tumbling out

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Our fire-maker left us last season. We keep fire. We cannot make it.

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: If the tiger comes tonight, what then?

steps: @Snail kneels on the damp cave floor hugging the cold bamboo ember tube to his chest and is already speaking through sobs, tears streaming.

@Moon keeps talking as her fingers spread over the ash where only a thin thread of smoke rises.

@Moon keeps speaking slowly and closes her palm into a loose fist above the cold ash.

turns.line: Rain isn't my fault! Give me till sunrise. I'll make fire!
turns.tone: fast and defiant, standing his ground

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Two days spinning sticks, and not even smoke.

@Khang keeps talking quickly and points one finger up at the stormy sky beyond the cave mouth.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: I once filmed an old Muong man making fire by sawing bamboo. I thought he was faking.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Bamboo burns. It doesn't make fire.

turns.speaker: @Khang

turns.speaker: @Khang

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Thunder brought us a fire-maker. Your name is Fire-Maker.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Twenty-nine years old, and this is my first fire ever.

@Moon keeps speaking and raises the green bamboo ember tube in both hands toward the flame.
@Moon keeps talking slowly, looking down at @Khang with calm piercing eyes.
@Moon finishes the naming, closes her mouth and lays one hand on @Khang's shoulder.

@Khang keeps speaking as a tear slides down his stubbled cheek, a shaky laugh in his breath.
@Khang keeps talking slowly, staring into the flames while the clan cheers behind him in soft focus.
@Khang says the last words in a near whisper and wipes his eyes with the red bandana on his wrist.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Still water has tiny bugs, too small to see. They bite you from inside.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Bugs we can't see? How do we catch them?

steps: @Stream kneels by a leaf bed beside the hearth, dabbing a wet leaf on the forehead of a small child curled under a hide, and is already speaking fast.

@Khang keeps speaking and squints at an imaginary speck held between his finger and thumb.
