steps: @Stream runs barefoot out of the dim cave past an empty bed of dry leaves and is already speaking fast, breath short, eyes on @Moon.
@Stream keeps talking as she points back at the flattened leaf bed, where no spear leans against the rock any more.
@Stream reaches @Moon's side at the misty cave mouth, finishes her words and closes her mouth, chest heaving.
@Moon keeps her eyes on the white mist below and begins answering slowly in a low husky voice, without turning her head.
@Moon keeps speaking slowly, her calm eyes fixed on the place where the jungle disappears into the mist.
@Moon's fingers tighten around the green bamboo ember tube against her hide cloak as she goes on.
@Moon talks on in a husky murmur, jaw set, a slow breath lifting her narrow shoulders.
@Moon lowers her eyes for a moment as she says the last heavy words.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, the red ochre dot on her forehead still in the grey light.
@Stream steps around to face her and starts speaking fast, both hands open, her voice climbing.
@Stream keeps talking quickly, pointing down into the mist toward the jungle, while @Moon listens with her mouth closed.
@Stream's breath catches as she goes on, the snail-shell necklace trembling on her chest.
@Stream finishes the last words and closes her mouth, staring at @Moon, jaw tight.
@Moon turns her head slowly toward @Stream, mouth closed, her lips pressed thin.
Both stand silent at the cave mouth as white mist drifts in around their bare feet, mouths closed.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Grandma, let me find him. I have a whistle. Stream knows tracks.
turns.tone: steady and practical, already geared up

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Roar wants you gone. Why look for him?

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Hating me doesn't make him less one of us. Our people come home.
turns.tone: quiet and sincere, the grin gone

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: boot laces pulled tight, a plastic whistle tapping against a chest strap, water dripping at the cave mouth, muffled birdcalls in the mist

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the young man in the olive shirt at the misty cave mouth, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the old clan leader, locked off
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the old woman onto the young man, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the young man, locked off

steps: @Khang yanks the laces of his brown hiking boots tight, straightens up and is already speaking to @Moon in an even, practical voice.
@Khang keeps talking as he lifts a plastic whistle on a cord and lets it drop against his chest harness.
@Khang slips a folded multitool into his trouser pocket while he goes on speaking.
@Khang nods toward the misty jungle below as he speaks, the small chest camera dark on its harness.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, waiting, both hands on the harness straps.
@Moon studies him and answers slowly in a low husky voice, her calm eyes narrowing.
@Moon keeps speaking, the green bamboo ember tube resting in the crook of her arm.
@Moon tilts her head as she finishes her question and closes her mouth.
@Khang holds her gaze in silence, mouth closed, breathing out once through his nose.
@Khang starts answering slowly and quietly, his showman grin gone, eyes steady on @Moon.
@Khang keeps talking in a low honest voice while @Moon watches him with her mouth closed.
@Khang touches two fingers to his own chest as he goes on speaking.
@Khang glances out toward the misty jungle below and keeps speaking softly, his voice low.
@Khang says the last words looking straight at @Moon, his stubbled jaw set.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth and waits, a strand of mist drifting across his face.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Roar's footprints follow the rhino tracks. Here, broken twigs, leaves turned over. Not long ago.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: A whistle carries farther than shouting. Three blasts means help. If he hears it, he'll shout back.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Shh... listen. Down there.

clips.setting: Deep primeval jungle in the Stone Age in the morning: damp earth with fresh footprints, broken twigs, leaves turned pale side up, giant trunks and hanging lianas, shafts of light through the canopy.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: damp leaves crunching underfoot, a twig cracking, water dripping from the canopy, insects humming, then near silence broken by three short shrill whistle blows echoing through the trees

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the young forager crouching over the footprints, slow push-in
50mm close-up of the young man lifting a whistle on a cord, handheld
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the young man onto the forager raising one hand, locked off
24mm wide shot of both among giant trunks and hanging lianas, slow push-in toward the dark undergrowth

steps: @Stream crouches low over a line of fresh bare footprints pressed into the damp earth and is already speaking in a low, certain voice.
@Stream traces the rim of a huge three-toed rhino print beside the human footprints with one finger as she talks.
@Stream picks up a snapped twig and turns it in a shaft of light, still speaking.
@Stream flips a fallen leaf over to show its pale underside while she keeps talking, @Khang bending close behind her.
@Stream presses two fingers into the soft edge of a footprint as she goes on.
@Stream finishes, closes her mouth and looks up at @Khang, eyes sharp.
@Khang lifts the plastic whistle on its cord from his chest and starts talking fast, eyebrows up, eager.
@Khang keeps speaking quickly, wagging the whistle between two fingers like a teacher.
@Khang holds up three fingers as he goes on, his showman energy back in his face.
@Khang talks on, pointing the whistle out toward the deep green trees.
@Khang keeps talking fast as he raises the whistle toward his lips.
@Khang closes his mouth with the whistle at his lips as @Stream flicks one flat hand up beside him, head cocked, listening.
@Stream whispers, barely moving, her eyes sliding toward the dark undergrowth down the slope.
@Stream finishes the whisper, closes her mouth and points one finger down the slope.
@Khang gives three short sharp whistle blows toward the slope while @Stream holds perfectly still beside him, mouth closed, listening.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Go away! I don't need pity! I can climb out myself!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: With your ankle that swollen? How? Sit still. Don't try to stand.
turns.tone: firm and calm, leaning over the rim

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: I've been here since night. The tiger walked the edge twice.

clips.setting: A limestone sinkhole in the primeval jungle at midday: a pit about four meters deep with steep mossy rock walls, ferns and reeds hanging over the rim, a big tree right at the edge, a shaft of sunlight reaching the soft earthen bottom.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: pebbles trickling down a rock wall, ferns rustling at the rim, a hoarse voice echoing off stone, cicadas droning, distant birds

shots.camera: 35mm high-angle medium shot from the rim down onto the hunter sitting against the rock wall, locked off
50mm low-angle close-up of the young man kneeling at the rim and looking down, slow push-in
40mm medium shot of the hunter at the bottom, his swollen ankle in the foreground, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the hunter's face in the shaft of sunlight, locked off

steps: @Roar sits slumped against the mossy rock wall at the bottom of the sinkhole and is already shouting up hoarsely, chin raised, eyes hard.
@Roar keeps shouting, one big hand waving the rim away, his bamboo spear lying flat in the dirt beside him.
@Roar pushes on the rock to rise, winces, and drops back down as he shouts the last words.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, breathing hard through his nose, his left ankle swollen and purple.
@Khang kneels at the fern-lined rim, both hands on the edge, and starts answering firmly, looking straight down.
@Khang keeps talking calmly, nodding down toward the purple swollen ankle at the bottom of the pit.
@Khang holds out one flat palm in a stay-there gesture as he goes on.
@Khang keeps speaking evenly, his eyes measuring the steep mossy wall below him.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, still leaning over the rim, fern fronds brushing his arms.
@Roar lets his head fall back against the rock and starts speaking low, the force draining out of his voice.
@Roar keeps talking slowly, his eyes drifting up to the fringe of reeds along the rim.
@Roar's broad shoulders sag as he goes on, his voice dropping lower.
@Roar speaks the last words almost under his breath, swallowing hard, his eyes still on the rim.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, his eyes still fixed on the bright rim above.
@Roar sits silent, mouth closed, his chest rising and falling slowly in the shaft of sunlight.

scenes.title: The Sinkhole (Hố sụt)
scenes.location: Hố sụt đá vôi giữa rừng, ánh nắng rọi xiên xuống đáy; một gốc cây to ở mép hố.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt ở mép hố phía gốc cây to: gốc cây bên trái, miệng hố ở giữa, vách đá rêu đối diện ở xa; dưới đáy hố Roar ngồi tựa vách bên phải, vệt nắng xiên rơi từ trái sang; Khang luôn ở phía trái Roar.
scenes.props: Ba sợi dây leo dài bện thành một sợi to, hai thanh gỗ thẳng làm nẹp, chiếc khăn rằn đỏ của Khang quấn nẹp, nút ghế quanh ngực Roar, gốc cây to ở mép hố để vòng dây, cây gậy chống của Roar.
scenes.setting: A limestone sinkhole in the primeval jungle at midday: a pit about four meters deep with steep mossy rock walls, ferns and reeds hanging over the rim, a big tree right at the edge, a shaft of sunlight reaching the soft earthen bottom.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: One vine snaps. Braid three together and it'll hold a buffalo. Pull it tight for me!

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Where did you learn this? We braid baskets, never rope this thick.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: The internet. I mean... a place very far away.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: long lianas tearing loose from a trunk with a rush of leaves, dry vine fibers creaking as they twist, cicadas droning, a woodpecker tapping far off

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of the pair pulling long lianas off a giant trunk at the sinkhole rim, handheld
50mm close-up of the young forager holding the braided end taut, slow push-in
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the forager onto the young man braiding, slow push-in

steps: @Khang hauls a long green liana down from a giant trunk at the sinkhole rim and is already talking fast, @Stream tugging another vine beside him.
@Khang snaps a single thin vine between his fists to show how weak it is, still talking.
@Khang lays three long vines side by side on the moss and starts braiding them, speaking quickly.
@Khang keeps talking as his hands flip the three strands over one another in a tight braid.
@Khang pushes the loose end toward @Stream and finishes his words with an urgent nod.
@Khang closes his mouth; @Stream takes hold of the end with both hands, braces her bare feet and starts asking, puzzled.
@Stream keeps speaking as she leans back and pulls the thick braid taut, eyes narrowing at it.
@Stream runs her thumb along the twisted strands while she talks, head tilted.
@Stream glances from the rope to the rattan basket on her own back as she goes on.
@Stream finishes her question and closes her mouth, eyebrows raised at @Khang.
@Khang freezes mid-braid, eyes darting sideways, then starts answering with an awkward half-laugh.
@Khang keeps talking, scratching his stubbled jaw with one hand, eyes sliding away from hers.
@Khang quickly corrects himself, waving one hand toward the far treetops as he speaks.
@Khang finishes with a sheepish grin and closes his mouth, going back to the braid.
@Khang twists the three strands tighter in silence, mouth closed, the thick green rope growing in his hands.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Not broken, just twisted. I'll splint it. If it hurts, scream. No shame in that.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Hunters don't scream! A hunter screams, the animals run! Argh!
turns.tone: through gritted teeth, then a roar

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: There are no animals down here. Just you and me.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

clips.sfx: two sticks knocking together, cloth knotted and pulled tight, harsh breathing echoing off the rock walls, pebbles trickling, cicadas far above

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the young man kneeling beside the hunter's swollen ankle at the bottom of the sinkhole, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the hunter's face, jaw clenched, handheld
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the hunter onto the young man, locked off
35mm medium two-shot of both against the mossy wall in the shaft of sunlight, locked off

steps: @Khang kneels on the soft earth beside @Roar, gently pressing the purple swollen ankle with two fingers, and is already speaking calmly.
@Khang keeps talking as he lays two straight sticks along either side of the ankle.
@Khang pulls the red bandana from his trouser pocket and keeps speaking evenly, eyes on the joint.
@Khang wraps the red bandana around the sticks while he goes on, glancing up at @Roar.
@Khang talks on with a small shrug, holding both ends of the bandana ready.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, then pulls the bandana knot tight around the splint.
@Roar clenches his jaw, the cords of his neck standing out, and starts speaking through gritted teeth.
@Roar keeps talking hard and fast, sweat on his heavy brows, both fists pressed into the dirt.
@Roar keeps speaking through his teeth, his head pressed back against the mossy rock.
@Roar lets out one hoarse cry, then clamps his mouth shut, panting through his nose.
@Khang ties off the knot, glances up at him and starts answering with a crooked smirk.
@Khang keeps talking dryly, opening one hand toward the empty pit around them.
@Khang tilts his head as he goes on, the smirk widening, while @Roar stares at him with his mouth closed.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, sitting back on his heels beside the neat red-bound splint.
@Roar lets out a long breath through his nose, mouth closed, the corner of his lip twitching.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Why save me? I wanted you out of our cave.
turns.tone: low and gruff, face turned away

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Where I'm from, the village helps whoever falls. Kick me out once you're up.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Strange knot. Tight, but it doesn't squeeze. Who taught you?

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana
wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

clips.sfx: the thick vine rope rasping as it is looped and knotted, heavy breathing, pebbles trickling down the wall, cicadas far above

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of both against the mossy wall, slow push-in
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the hunter onto the young man tying the rope, locked off
85mm close-up of the hunter studying the knot on his chest, slow push-in
35mm medium two-shot of both at the bottom of the sinkhole, locked off

steps: @Roar turns his face aside from @Khang toward the mossy wall and is already speaking, low and gruff.
@Roar keeps talking slowly, his jaw working, as @Khang loops the thick vine rope behind his back.
@Roar goes on in a rough murmur, still refusing to look at @Khang, his wooden staff propped beside him.
@Roar keeps speaking, staring at the rock as @Khang passes the rope across his broad chest over the boar-hide vest.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, nostrils flaring, his face still turned to the rock.
@Khang forms a small loop in the rope and starts answering in an even, matter-of-fact voice.
@Khang keeps talking as he feeds the rope end up through the small loop.
@Khang goes on speaking while he takes the end around the standing rope, eyes on his hands.
@Khang talks on with a wry little shrug, tucking the end back down through the loop.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, pulling the knot snug against @Roar's chest.
@Roar looks down at the knot and starts speaking, his heavy brows drawing together.
@Roar keeps talking as he tugs the rope with one hand and feels the loop stay firm without tightening.
@Roar runs his thumb over the knot as he goes on, a grudging note in his voice.
@Roar lifts his eyes to @Khang at last and asks the last words, his voice rough.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth; @Khang just taps the knot twice with a small grin, mouth closed.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Pull! One, two, three! Around the tree, so he can't fall!

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: I'm up. From today, you are my brother. Whoever wants you gone, goes through me.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Then, Roar, stop calling me stranger, okay?

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana
wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

clips.sfx: the vine rope creaking around a tree trunk, bark rasping, grunts of effort, soil and pebbles spilling into the pit, heavy panting, leaves rustling

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the young man hauling the rope wrapped around the big tree trunk, handheld
24mm wide shot of the sinkhole rim as the hunter is hauled up onto the grass, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the hunter lying on his back in the grass, locked off
35mm medium two-shot of both on the grassy rim, slow push-in

steps: @Khang braces his boots against the roots of the big tree, the vine rope wrapped once around its trunk, and is already shouting the rhythm, hauling hard.
@Khang heaves back on the rope, still shouting, while a second pair of hands hauls behind him in soft focus.
@Khang keeps shouting as the rope creaks around the trunk and inches up out of the pit.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, leaning his whole weight back, teeth bared with effort.
@Roar rolls over the grassy rim onto his back, the red-bound splint dragging behind him, and starts speaking between gasps.
@Roar lies flat on the grass, chest heaving, and keeps talking breathlessly up at the sky.
@Roar turns his head toward @Khang, still talking, sweat running into his heavy brows.
@Roar speaks slowly and solemnly, his deep-set eyes fixed on @Khang, his breath still ragged.
@Roar lifts one big hand off the grass as he keeps talking, his voice rough and steady.
@Roar says the last words with weight, jaw set, his hand held out.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, his hand still raised, breathing hard.
@Khang drops to one knee beside him, clasps the raised hand and starts answering with a breathless laugh.
@Khang keeps talking, grinning wide, as he pulls @Roar up to sitting on the grassy rim.
@Khang finishes with a wink and closes his mouth, still holding the big hand in his.
@Roar huffs a short laugh through his nose, mouth closed, still holding @Khang's hand, both chests heaving.

scenes.title: Muddy Water (Nước đục)
scenes.time_label: Chiều ngày 6, bờ suối trên đường về (14:00–15:00)
scenes.location: Bờ suối chiều; nước đột ngột đục ngầu, cành lá trôi nhanh; xa xa trên đầu nguồn, mây đen đặc như mực trùm đỉnh núi, chớp loé không tiếng, trong khi trên đầu vẫn nắng.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt trên bờ suối nhìn ngược dòng: nước đục chảy từ đầu nguồn ở xa (mây đen trên đỉnh núi) về phía máy, bãi lau bên trái, các tảng đá lớn và vách đá vôi bên phải; nắng chiều chiếu từ phía sau máy.
scenes.props: Dòng suối đục nâu chảy xiết, cành cây và lá trôi nhanh, vệt nước ướt leo dần trên đá, gậy chống và nẹp chân quấn khăn đỏ của Roar, tảng đá cao Khang đứng chỉ tay, bãi lau, mây đen trùm đầu nguồn.
scenes.setting: A jungle stream bank in the Stone Age in late afternoon: the water suddenly brown and fast, branches and leaves racing past, reed beds and big rocks along the bank, the sun still bright overhead while black clouds cover the distant headwater peaks.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Wait. This morning the stream was clear. Why is it brown now?

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Rain upstream makes the water brown. Every season. Nothing to fear.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: It's sunny here. But look at those branches racing. The water's rising fast!

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana
wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

clips.sfx: fast muddy water rushing and gurgling, a heavy branch knocking against rocks as it races past, reeds hissing in the wind, a wooden staff tapping on stones

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of the young man helping the limping hunter along the stream bank, handheld follow
85mm close-up of the hunter leaning on his staff, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the hunter onto the young man, handheld
24mm wide shot of the brown stream racing past the pair as a big branch sweeps by, slow pan

steps: @Khang walks along the stream bank with @Roar's arm over his shoulder, stops short, and is already speaking uneasily, eyes on the water.
@Khang keeps talking as he stares at the brown, fast water churning where it ran clear this morning.
@Khang leans closer to the water, still speaking, while @Roar steadies himself on his wooden staff.
@Khang dips two fingers into the muddy water and frowns at them as he talks.
@Khang finishes his question and closes his mouth, looking up at @Roar.
@Roar waves one big hand at the water and starts answering in a gruff, dismissive voice.
@Roar keeps talking, shifting his weight onto the staff to spare the splinted ankle.
@Roar shrugs his broad shoulders as he goes on, unbothered, his eyes already on the path ahead.
@Roar keeps speaking, half turning to limp on along the bank, the staff tapping the stones.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, already limping one step forward along the reed-lined bank.
@Khang takes hold of @Roar's arm, points up at the bright sun and starts talking fast.
@Khang keeps speaking quickly, swinging his pointing hand down to the racing water.
A thick leafy branch races past them on the brown current as @Khang keeps talking, pointing after it.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, eyes darting to the wet line on the rocks where the water is climbing.
@Roar stares down at the rising water in silence, mouth closed, his knuckles tightening on the staff.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Look, black clouds all over the headwaters. Tonight all that water comes here.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Our cave sits by the stream. Can water reach our beds?

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Flash floods don't creep. It hits all at once and takes everything!

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

clips.sfx: rushing brown water below, a low far-off rumble of thunder from the distant peaks, reeds hissing in a rising wind, bare feet scraping on rock

shots.camera: 35mm low-angle medium shot of the young man standing on a tall rock and pointing upstream, handheld
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the young man onto the forager climbing up beside him, locked off
85mm close-up of the young man with the wind in his face, slow push-in
24mm wide shot from behind both on the rock toward black clouds over the distant peaks under a bright sun, locked off

steps: @Khang scrambles up onto a tall rock above the bank, straightens, and is already speaking fast, one arm stretched toward the upstream peaks.
@Khang keeps talking, squinting past the bright sun at a wall of black clouds over the distant headwaters.
@Khang turns his head back toward the bank as he goes on, his pointing arm still raised.
@Khang keeps speaking quickly, sweeping his hand from the clouds down along the brown stream.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth as @Stream climbs the rock beside him, bare feet finding the cracks.
@Stream straightens, follows his arm with her eyes and starts asking in a low, careful voice.
@Stream keeps talking, glancing down at the brown water racing along the foot of the rock.
@Stream's hand closes around the snail-shell necklace on her chest as she goes on.
@Stream finishes her question and closes her mouth, her lips pressed pale.
@Khang turns to face her and starts answering fast and sharp, no grin left on his face.
@Khang keeps talking, slicing one flat hand down through the air like a falling wall of water.
@Khang goes on quickly, his eyes locked on hers, his jaw tight.
@Khang finishes the last words and closes his mouth, breathing hard, his eyes still on hers.
@Stream turns back toward the black clouds in silence, mouth closed, the wind whipping her long hair.
Both stand still on the rock under the bright sun, mouths closed, while thunder rolls faintly from the dark peaks.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: When I was small, water once filled the lower cave. Some elders didn't make it.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Then we can't wait! Is there higher ground?

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: The upper cave, in the cliff. Stream, take Fire the short way!

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana
wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

clips.sfx: the brown current roaring louder, a branch thudding against rocks, thunder rumbling far upstream, reeds thrashing in the wind

shots.camera: 85mm close-up of the hunter leaning on his staff, eyes on the black clouds, slow push-in
50mm medium two-shot of the hunter and the young man on the bank, locked off
85mm close-up of the young man turning sharply, handheld
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the young man onto the hunter pointing toward the cliffs, slow push-in

steps: @Roar leans on his wooden staff staring upstream at the black clouds and is already speaking slowly, his voice low and far away.
@Roar keeps talking, his heavy brows drawing down, the brown water roaring past below him.
@Roar's eyes darken and go distant as he goes on, his knuckles pale on the staff.
@Roar keeps speaking slowly, swallowing once between the words, his gaze fixed on the clouds.
@Roar lowers his head as he talks on, while @Khang turns to stare at him.
@Roar says the last heavy words almost under his breath, his grip loosening on the staff.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, jaw tight, eyes on the ground.
@Khang turns sharply toward @Roar and starts talking fast, his breath quick.
@Khang keeps speaking quickly, his eyes searching the cliffs above the trees.
@Khang finishes the question and closes his mouth, staring at @Roar, his chest rising fast.
@Roar lifts his head, raises his staff toward the distant limestone cliffs and starts answering fast and firm.
@Roar keeps talking with force, holding the staff high toward a dark ledge on the cliff face.
@Roar turns his head over his shoulder as he calls out the last order, his voice booming.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, the staff still raised toward the cliff.
@Khang nods once, mouth closed, already backing away along the bank toward the reeds.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: This way! Through the reeds, across the rocks, then the cave! Stay close!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: What if Grandma doesn't believe me? Back home, even the truth gets ignored.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Here is different. I believe you. Grandmother listens to me.
turns.tone: steady, eyes ahead, not looking back

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

clips.sfx: bare feet and boots pounding through reeds, reed stalks swishing and whipping, ragged breathing, splashes on wet rocks, the stream roaring behind

shots.camera: 35mm medium tracking shot leading the young forager as she runs through tall reeds, handheld
50mm close-up of the young man running and panting, handheld follow
35mm medium tracking shot leading the forager across wet rocks, handheld
24mm wide shot of both leaping a gap between big rocks toward the limestone cliff, locked off

steps: @Stream sprints into a wall of tall reeds, swinging one arm forward, and is already shouting directions without breaking stride.
@Stream keeps calling out fast, pushing reed stalks aside, her long hair flying.
@Stream glances back once over her shoulder as she keeps talking, reed leaves whipping her arms.
@Stream keeps shouting, pointing ahead toward a line of wet rocks beyond the last reeds.
@Stream closes her mouth, eyes forward, as @Khang crashes through the reeds behind her, chest heaving.
@Khang starts talking between ragged breaths, sweat streaming down his stubbled face as he runs.
@Khang keeps speaking, half to himself, ducking a whipping reed as his boots slip in the mud.
@Khang goes on panting the words, his chest harness bouncing against his shirt.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, gulping air, his eyes on her back ahead of him.
@Stream hops onto the first wet rock and starts answering steadily, eyes ahead, never looking back.
@Stream keeps talking calmly as she jumps from rock to rock, arms out for balance.
@Stream goes on in a firm even voice, her bare feet sure on the slick stone.
@Stream finishes the last words and closes her mouth, a small set smile on her lips.
@Stream leaps a gap between two big rocks, mouth closed, with @Khang landing right behind her.
Both run on along the rocks toward the distant limestone cliff, mouths closed, the brown stream roaring beside them.

scenes.title: Nobody Believes (Không ai tin)
scenes.location: Hang dưới chiều muộn: cả hang đang nướng cá từ cái lờ, trẻ con chơi đùa, ánh nắng vàng hắt vào cửa hang, tiếng suối dưới chân hang đã to hơn.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt trong lòng hang nhìn ra cửa hang vòm rộng: bếp lửa ở giữa, Grandma Moon ngồi bên trái bếp, quần chúng ngồi quanh bếp, cửa hang sáng nắng vàng ở xa phía sau, nhũ đá hình con voi bên phải; người từ ngoài vào luôn đi từ cửa hang về phía máy.
scenes.props: Bếp lửa nướng cá xiên que, ống tre xanh giữ than của Grandma Moon, dây leo buộc trẻ con vào người lớn, gậy chống và nẹp chân quấn khăn đỏ của Roar, nhũ đá hình voi, tiếng suối đục ngoài cửa hang.
scenes.setting: Late afternoon inside the large Stone Age clan cave: golden light through the wide arched mouth, the elephant-shaped stalactite, bare rock walls, the clan grilling fish over the hearth, the stream below the entrance now loud and brown.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Grandma, we must move to the upper cave now! A flood is coming tonight!

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: The sky is clear. It is not the water season. Why frighten the cave?

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: The stream's brown and rising! I saw it myself!

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

clips.sfx: running boots on the rock floor, ragged breathing, fish sizzling over the hearth, a crackling fire, chatter dying away, the stream roaring louder outside

shots.camera: 24mm wide shot from the hearth toward the golden cave mouth as the young man runs in, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the old clan leader seated by the hearth, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the old woman onto the young man, slow push-in

steps: @Khang runs in through the golden cave mouth toward the hearth, sweat-soaked and gasping, and is already shouting toward @Moon.
@Khang skids to a stop by the fire, still talking fast, as the seated clan members freeze with fish skewers in their hands.
@Khang points back out of the cave mouth toward the stream as he keeps speaking.
@Khang keeps talking urgently, hands on his knees for one breath, then straightening.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, chest heaving, sweat dripping from his chin, eyes on @Moon.
@Moon stays seated by the hearth, only lifting her head, and starts answering slowly and calmly.
@Moon keeps speaking in her low husky voice, her eyes steady on @Khang.
@Moon tilts her chin toward the bright sky beyond the cave mouth as she goes on.
@Moon talks on slowly, turning a fish skewer over the coals with one hand.
@Moon's gaze sweeps across the hushed clan around the fire as she keeps speaking.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, eyebrows slightly raised at @Khang, her hands still on the skewer.
@Khang steps closer to the fire and starts talking fast, his voice cracking with urgency.
@Khang keeps speaking, flinging one arm back toward the roaring stream outside.
@Khang presses a hand flat to his own chest as he goes on.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, breathing hard, while @Moon watches him without a word.
clips.extras: a few clan members in bark-cloth tunics and hide wraps sit around the hearth holding fish skewers, freezing mid-bite, in soft focus

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Climbing to the upper cave at night, children and elders fall.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Grandmother, Fire has never been wrong. Fire, boiled water, the fish trap!

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: If he's wrong, the cave climbs in the dark for a stranger.

clips.sfx: a low murmur running through the clan, a small child whimpering, the fire crackling, fish fat hissing on the coals, the stream roaring outside

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the old clan leader seated by the hearth, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the young forager stepping forward into the firelight, handheld
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the forager onto the old woman, locked off
85mm close-up of the old clan leader, slow push-in

steps: @Moon sits by the hearth with the green bamboo ember tube across her knees and is already speaking in a measured voice.
@Moon keeps talking evenly as, behind her in soft focus, mothers draw small children closer.
@Moon raises one weathered hand, palm down, as she goes on in the same even voice.
@Moon keeps speaking, her eyes moving over the children and the old ones by the fire.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, lowering her hand to the bamboo tube.
@Stream steps forward into the firelight and starts speaking fast, chin raised.
@Stream keeps talking quickly, counting off on her fingers as she leans toward @Moon.
@Stream folds down one more finger as she goes on, the red ochre stripes on her cheeks catching the firelight.
@Stream finishes and closes her mouth, standing straight, breathing hard, her fists closed at her sides.
@Moon looks up at @Stream and starts answering slowly and gravely, her voice dropping low.
@Moon keeps speaking low, her lined face lit by the fire, while @Stream listens with her mouth closed.
@Moon turns her head toward the golden cave mouth as she goes on.
@Moon talks on slowly, her fingers resting on the green bamboo ember tube in her lap.
@Moon says the last words looking straight at @Stream, her jaw firm.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, her calm eyes unmoving, as the murmur of the clan dies down.
clips.extras: clan members in bark-cloth tunics and hide wraps murmur around the hearth, mothers pulling small children close, in soft focus

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: He is no stranger. He saved me from the pit, with the tiger circling. I trust him.
turns.tone: slow and loud, every word a vow

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Roar? You hated him most.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Hate was yesterday. Muddy water is tonight. Grandmother, take the cave up!

wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

clips.sfx: a wooden staff thudding on rock, a dragging bare foot, the fire crackling in a sudden hush, the stream roaring outside

shots.camera: 24mm wide shot from the hearth toward the golden cave mouth as the hunter limps in on his staff, locked off
50mm medium shot of the hunter stopping before the seated old woman, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the old clan leader looking up, locked off
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the old woman onto the hunter, slow push-in

steps: @Roar limps in through the golden cave mouth on his wooden staff, the red-bound splint on his left ankle, and is already speaking slowly and loudly.
@Roar keeps talking as he drags the splinted foot across the rock floor, the hushed clan turning to stare.
@Roar plants his staff with a thud and goes on, his deep voice filling the cave.
@Roar keeps speaking slowly, each word heavy, his eyes fixed on @Moon by the hearth.
@Roar stops before @Moon and lays one hand on his own boar-hide chest as he speaks.
@Roar keeps talking, tipping his chin back toward the cave mouth and the jungle beyond it.
@Roar says the last words firmly, looking down into @Moon's upturned face, his jaw set.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, standing tall on his staff in the silent cave.
@Moon looks up at him, her lips parting, and asks almost in a whisper.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, her calm eyes wide for once.
@Roar shakes his head once and starts answering fast and forceful, leaning on his staff.
@Roar keeps talking hard, pointing his staff out toward the roaring brown stream.
@Roar leans toward @Moon as he goes on, his boar-tusk necklace swinging.
@Roar calls out the last words with force, one big hand sweeping upward toward the cliff.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, breathing hard, waiting for @Moon's answer in the silent cave.
clips.extras: the whole clan in bark-cloth tunics and hide wraps sits around the hearth, falling silent and turning to look, in soft focus

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Everyone! Children first. Snail, carry the fire tube. Don't let it die.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Tie each child to an adult! Stream and I go last!

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Fire-Maker. If no water comes, you leave at sunrise.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

clips.sfx: the clan stirring, hide bundles rustling, vine cords pulled tight, children's quick footsteps, the hearth crackling, the stream roaring outside

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the old clan leader rising by the hearth and holding out the bamboo ember tube, slow push-in
50mm close-up of the young man knotting a vine cord, handheld
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the young man onto the old woman, locked off
85mm close-up of the old clan leader, slow push-in

steps: @Moon rises from the hearth, straight-backed, and is already speaking in a firm voice that carries across the cave.
@Moon keeps talking as the clan members around the fire scramble to their feet in soft focus.
@Moon holds out the green bamboo ember tube as she goes on, and a small child's hands reach in from the frame edge to take it.
@Moon keeps speaking, her hand lingering on the tube a moment before she lets go.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, watching the small hands carry the tube away.
@Khang kneels beside a small child, ties a loose vine safety cord around the child's waist and starts talking fast over his shoulder.
@Khang keeps calling out quickly as he ties the other end to the wrist of a woman beside the child.
@Khang keeps speaking, tugging the knot twice to test it, eyes sweeping the cave.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, rising to his feet, breathing fast.
@Moon turns, looks straight at @Khang and starts speaking slowly and evenly.
@Moon keeps talking in a low steady voice, while @Khang stands still with his mouth closed.
@Moon takes one step toward him as she goes on, her hide cloak swaying.
@Moon says the last words slowly, her calm eyes never leaving his face.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, the red ochre dot steady on her forehead.
@Moon holds his gaze in silence, mouth closed, as the golden light fades on the cave wall behind her.
clips.extras: clan members in bark-cloth tunics and hide wraps gather bundles while small children are joined to adults by loose vine safety cords, in soft focus

scenes.title: Flood Night (Lũ đêm)
scenes.location: Đêm mưa. Hang trên là một mái đá hẹp giữa vách núi, đuốc lập loè, cả hang chen chúc. Dưới chân vách, nước bùn gầm lên tràn bãi suối. Hang dưới tối om, nước đã vào đến lòng hang.
scenes.axis: Ở hang trên, máy đặt dưới mái đá nhìn ra vực: vách đá và đuốc bên trái, mép vực và dây leo thả xuống bên phải, dòng lũ bùn và cửa hang dưới ở xa phía dưới; ở hang dưới máy đặt trong lòng hang nhìn ra cửa, cột đá có gờ ở giữa, nước bùn tràn vào từ cửa hang phía xa, tảng đá lớn ở chân vách ngoài cửa.
scenes.props: Đuốc nhựa cây, dây leo bện ba sợi thả xuống vách, đèn đội đầu và chiếc còi của Khang, ống tre giữ lửa còn than đỏ trong tay Snail, cột đá có gờ trong hang dưới, tảng đá lớn ở chân vách, nẹp chân quấn khăn đỏ của Roar.
scenes.setting: Night during a flash flood in the Stone Age: a narrow ledge-cave high on a limestone cliff lit by flickering torches, heavy rain, and far below a roaring brown flood surging over the stream banks toward the mouth of the lower cave.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Grandmother, one is missing! Where's Snail? Has anyone seen Snail?

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: The fire tube is gone too. He put it down to climb.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: He went back down for the fire. Since the night it died, he blames himself.
turns.tone: slow and numb, the truth sinking in

clips.sfx: heavy rain hammering the rock, torches sputtering and hissing in the wind, the flood roaring far below, a baby whimpering, thunder rolling

shots.camera: 35mm medium tracking shot of the young forager moving along a row of huddled children under the ledge, handheld follow
85mm close-up of the old clan leader staring at an empty hollow in the rock, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the old woman onto the forager, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the forager in the torchlight, locked off

steps: @Stream moves fast along a row of huddled children under the torchlit rock overhang, touching each small shoulder, and is already speaking breathlessly.
@Stream keeps talking fast, spinning to search the faces packed under the ledge, rain blowing in behind her.
@Stream touches the last small shoulder and her hand stops in midair as she keeps calling out.
@Stream finishes and closes her mouth, her face pale in the torchlight, chest heaving.
@Moon stares at an empty hollow in the rock beside her and starts speaking fast, her voice shaking.
@Moon keeps talking quickly, touching the bare stone where the green bamboo ember tube lay.
@Moon's weathered fingers tremble on the cold wet rock as she goes on.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, lips pressed tight, eyes on the empty hollow.
@Stream turns slowly toward the edge of the ledge and starts speaking low and slow, each word heavy.
@Stream keeps talking, staring down past the ledge into the dark rain and the roaring flood below.
@Stream's hand closes around the snail-shell necklace at her chest as she goes on speaking.
@Stream keeps speaking slowly, her lower lip trembling between the words, rain on her lashes.
@Stream swallows and says the last words almost to herself, her eyes glistening in the torchlight.
@Stream keeps speaking in a low voice, rain beading on the red ochre stripes on her cheeks.
@Stream finishes and closes her mouth, breathing shakily, her eyes fixed on the darkness below.
clips.extras: the clan in bark-cloth tunics and hide wraps huddles under the rock overhang by torchlight, small children sitting in a row, in soft focus

wardrobe.@Moon: a long dark hide cloak over a knee-length bark-cloth tunic, empty-handed with no bamboo tube, barefoot

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: Found it! Still glowing! Little fire, this time I won't let you die!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Snail! Stay there, hold the stone pillar! I'm coming down! When I whistle, shout back!

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: Fire! The water's up to my legs! I'm here!

clips.setting: Night in the flooding lower Stone Age cave and the cliff face above it: brown water pouring in through the wide mouth and rising around stone pillars, the elephant-shaped stalactite, rain lashing the cliff where a vine rope hangs down from torchlight high above.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

clips.sfx: brown water gushing into the cave and swirling around stone pillars, rain lashing the cliff, a vine rope creaking, boots scraping on wet rock, embers hissing softly inside a bamboo tube

shots.camera: 50mm close-up of the boy standing on a ledge of a stone pillar in the dark flooded cave, red ember glow on his face, slow push-in
35mm medium shot of the young man roping down the rain-lashed cliff, his headlamp beam cutting the rain, handheld
50mm close-up of the boy clinging to the stone pillar above the swirling water, handheld
24mm wide shot of the rain-lashed cliff and the flooded cave mouth at its foot as a headlamp beam descends, locked off

steps: @Snail stands on a dry ledge of a stone pillar in the dark flooded cave, hugging the bamboo tube, and is already speaking in quick panting gasps.
@Snail peeks into the open end of the tube at the red glowing embers, still talking fast, his eyes shining.
@Snail presses the tube against his small chest as he keeps talking to it, brown water swirling around the pillar below his feet.
@Snail keeps speaking breathlessly to the embers, a shaky grin on his round face, his head and shoulders dry.
@Snail finishes and closes his mouth and wraps one arm around the stone pillar, brown water lapping at the ledge below his bare feet.
On the cliff above, @Khang hangs on the braided vine rope against the wet rock, his headlamp beam cutting down through the rain, and starts shouting downward.
@Khang keeps shouting as he walks his boots down the wet rock, the rope wrapped around his waist and over one shoulder.
@Khang keeps calling out, rain streaming down his stubbled face, his eyes searching the dark cave mouth below.
@Khang lowers himself another stride down the cliff, still shouting through the rain.
Down in the flooded cave, @Snail jerks his head up toward the cave mouth and starts crying out, tears on his cheeks.
@Snail keeps shouting, his voice cracking, hugging the tube and the pillar together.
@Snail calls out again, glancing at the brown water swirling just below the ledge, his head and shoulders dry.
@Snail finishes and closes his mouth, his small chest hitching, his eyes on the cave mouth.
On the cliff, the white headlamp beam swings toward the flooded cave mouth far below as @Khang slides faster down the rope, mouth closed.
@Khang's small lit figure descends the rain-lashed cliff toward the dark cave mouth, where a faint red ember glow flickers inside, mouth closed.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: The rope only reaches the big rock! Past that, I can't hold you!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Enough! Hold tight, back against the rock. Don't stand on that ankle!

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Fire! Bring the boy back. And bring yourself back too!

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana
wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

clips.sfx: rain hammering the ledge, the vine rope creaking and rasping over rock, torches hissing, the flood roaring below, a long roll of thunder

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the hunter sitting braced against a rock at the ledge edge with the rope wrapped around his back, handheld
50mm high-angle close-up of the young man hanging on the rope below, looking up into the rain, handheld
50mm low-angle medium shot of the hunter at the ledge edge in the rain and torchlight, slow push-in
24mm wide shot down the wet cliff from the ledge along the taut rope, locked off

steps: @Roar sits braced against a rock at the edge of the torchlit ledge, the vine rope wrapped around his back, and is already shouting down into the rain.
@Roar keeps shouting, both fists locked on the rope, his splinted leg stretched straight out in front of him.
@Roar leans back hard against the rock as the rope jerks taut, still shouting.
@Roar keeps shouting down, rain running off his heavy brows and his boar-tusk necklace.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, teeth gritted, holding the rope tight against his back.
Below the ledge, @Khang hangs on the taut rope against the wet cliff, tips his head back and starts shouting up, firm and fast.
@Khang keeps shouting up, one hand flat against the rock, his headlamp beam glaring into the rain.
@Khang points up at the ledge as he goes on shouting, water streaming off his chin.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, then walks his boots another step down the cliff.
@Roar plants his good heel against a ridge of rock, leans back and starts shouting down, deep and booming.
@Roar keeps shouting, the rope sliding slowly through his fists as he pays it out.
@Roar's jaw clenches as he goes on, rain lashing across the torchlight.
@Roar finishes the last words and closes his mouth, breathing hard, his eyes locked on the dark below.
Seen from the ledge, the taut rope runs down the wet cliff to @Khang's small figure and white headlamp beam as he descends, mouth closed.
@Khang's headlamp drops steadily toward the brown flood churning at the foot of the cliff while the rope creaks.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Snail! Your hand! Arms around my neck, don't let go!

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: The fire tube! I'm not letting go! Grandmother said don't let it die!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Fine, keep it! Onto that rock, quick, here comes the water!

clips.setting: Night in the flooding lower Stone Age cave and the cliff face above it: brown water pouring in through the wide mouth and rising around stone pillars, the elephant-shaped stalactite, rain lashing the cliff where a vine rope hangs down from torchlight high above.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

clips.sfx: brown water churning and roaring through the cave mouth, boots sloshing through deep water, rain lashing outside, a rising rumble as a surge of muddy water rolls in

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the young man wading into the flooded cave as his headlamp beam finds the boy on the pillar, handheld follow
50mm close-up of the boy on the young man's shoulders hugging the bamboo tube, handheld
24mm wide shot leading the young man as he wades out of the cave mouth with the boy on his shoulders toward a huge boulder, handheld
50mm low-angle medium shot of both on top of the huge boulder as a surge of brown water rolls past below, locked off

steps: @Khang wades through brown water up to his thighs into the dark flooded cave, his headlamp beam sweeping, and is already shouting toward a stone pillar.
@Khang keeps shouting as his beam lands on @Snail standing on a dry pillar ledge above the swirling water, hugging the bamboo tube.
@Khang reaches the pillar and holds up both arms to @Snail, still shouting fast.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, lifts @Snail off the ledge and swings him up onto his shoulders, the water only at his own thighs.
@Snail sits high on @Khang's shoulders, one arm hugging the bamboo tube, and starts crying out stubbornly, tears streaming.
@Snail keeps talking through his tears, refusing to let go of the tube, his head and shoulders dry high above the water.
@Snail clutches the tube tighter against his chest as he keeps crying out, the red ember glow on his chin.
@Snail finishes and closes his mouth, his small chest hitching, one hand holding on to @Khang's hair.
@Khang turns toward the cave mouth and starts answering fast, half laughing, his eyes on a huge boulder outside.
@Khang keeps shouting as he wades out through the cave mouth, the brown water at his thighs, @Snail held tight on his shoulders.
@Khang keeps talking fast, nodding toward the huge boulder at the foot of the cliff.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, pushing through the current toward the boulder.
@Khang hauls himself up onto the wet boulder with @Snail on his shoulders, mouth closed, his boots scrabbling on the rock.
@Khang sets @Snail down on the flat top of the boulder and crouches over him, both mouths closed.
A surge of muddy brown water rolls past the boulder and into the cave mouth below them while @Khang and @Snail hold still on the dry top, mouths closed.

scenes.title: Three Million and One Boy (Ba triệu người và một thằng nhóc)
scenes.location: Đỉnh tảng đá lớn ở chân vách, nước bùn cuồn cuộn quanh, mưa quất; phía trên, mép hang trên với đuốc và bóng người.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt ngang đỉnh tảng đá lớn nhìn về phía vách núi: Khang và Snail trên đỉnh tảng đá ở giữa, vách đá ướt và dây leo thả xuống bên trái, mép hang trên với đuốc ở cao phía trên, dòng lũ bùn chảy từ phải sang trái bên dưới; cảnh trên mép hang trên nhìn xuống theo chiều ngược lại.
scenes.props: Ống tre giữ lửa còn than đỏ, chiếc còi và đèn đội đầu của Khang, camera nhỏ trên đai ngực với đèn đỏ nhấp nháy, dây leo bện có buộc hòn đá ở đầu, nút ghế quanh người Snail, đuốc trên mép hang trên.
scenes.setting: Night at the foot of the limestone cliff during the flood: the flat top of a huge boulder just above churning brown water, rain lashing, torchlight from a ledge-cave high above, a vine rope hanging down the wet rock face.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Everyone! Down here! Two of us, both alive!

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: Fire... the water's higher. Will the rock get swept away?

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: This rock is huge, the water can't move it. See the torches? Stream's throwing a rope.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

clips.sfx: churning brown floodwater roaring around the boulder, rain lashing stone, torches hissing high above, distant thunder, three short shrill whistle blows at the very end

50mm close-up of the boy huddled on the boulder top hugging the bamboo tube, locked off

steps: @Khang stands on top of the huge boulder in the churning brown flood, one arm around @Snail, and is already shouting up the dark cliff at full voice.
@Khang keeps shouting upward, cupping his free hand beside his mouth, rain lashing across his headlamp beam.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, breathing hard, staring up at the torches high on the ledge.
@Snail huddles against @Khang's side on the flat boulder top, hugging the bamboo tube, and starts speaking in a small shaking voice.
@Snail keeps talking slowly, his eyes on the brown water churning below the edge of the boulder, his head and shoulders dry.
@Snail's lower lip trembles as he goes on, rain dripping from the tuft of hair on his head.
@Snail tightens his arms around the tube as he asks the last words.
@Snail finishes and closes his mouth, looking up at @Khang with big wet eyes.
@Khang crouches down to @Snail's level and starts answering gently, one hand flat on the rough rock.
@Khang keeps speaking softly, patting the huge boulder under them twice with his open hand.
@Khang turns his head and his headlamp beam up toward the cliff as he goes on talking.
@Khang keeps talking calmly, pointing up at the flickering torches on the ledge high above.
@Khang says the last words with a steady half smile, rain running down his stubbled face.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, still looking up at the torches.
@Khang lifts the whistle to his lips and gives three short sharp blows toward the ledge, his eyes fixed on the torchlight.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Fire! The rope has a stone! Hands up and catch!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Got it! Tying Snail first. Bowline, it won't slip, don't worry!

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Snail, hug the fire tube! The whole cave is pulling! One, two, pull!

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

clips.sfx: rain hammering the ledge, a stone-weighted rope whirring through the air and thudding onto the boulder, the vine rope creaking, the clan grunting as they haul, the flood roaring below

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the young forager at the edge of the torchlit ledge swinging a stone-weighted rope, handheld
50mm close-up of the young man on the boulder catching the rope, handheld
35mm low-angle medium shot of the forager hauling the rope with the clan behind her, slow push-in
24mm wide shot from the ledge down the wet cliff as a small child rises on the rope toward the torches, locked off

steps: @Stream stands at the edge of the torchlit ledge swinging a vine rope with a stone tied to its end, and is already shouting down into the rain.
@Stream keeps shouting as she tosses the weighted rope out over the edge, rain streaming down her face.
@Stream leans out to watch it fall, still shouting down, one hand braced on the wet rock.
@Stream finishes and closes her mouth, holding the upper end of the rope, her eyes locked on the boulder below.
Down on the boulder, @Khang catches the weighted end of the rope in both hands and starts shouting up fast.
@Khang keeps talking quickly while his hands loop the rope as a harness around a small back in soft focus beside him.
@Khang keeps speaking fast as his fingers form a bowline knot, his eyes flicking up to the ledge.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, tugs the knot twice and raises a thumb to the ledge.
@Stream, rope in both hands at the ledge edge with the clan lined up behind her, starts shouting down fast.
@Stream keeps shouting, leaning her whole weight back on the rope as the hands behind her haul.
@Stream calls out the count, heaving on the rope with each word, wet hair stuck to her cheeks.
@Stream finishes and closes her mouth, hauling hand over hand, teeth clenched.
Looking down from the ledge, a small child with his back to camera rises up the wet cliff on the rope, hugging a glowing bamboo tube.
@Stream hauls hand over hand at the frame edge, mouth closed, as the small child comes closer to the torchlight.
Far below on the boulder, @Khang's headlamp beam follows the rising rope, his mouth closed.
clips.extras: clan members in bark-cloth tunics and hide wraps line the torchlit ledge behind her, hauling on the rope in soft focus

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: The strap snapped! No... all seven days are in there!

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Fire! Let the seeing stone go! Hold the rope with both hands!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Go, then. Three million viewers aren't worth one boy holding a fire tube.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

clips.sfx: a sharp plastic click as a buckle pops open, rain hammering, the flood roaring around the boulder, a small splash, the vine rope creaking taut

shots.camera: 50mm close-up of the young man on the boulder as his chest-harness buckle pops open, handheld
35mm low-angle medium shot of the young forager at the ledge edge shouting down with the rope in her hands, handheld
85mm close-up of the young man holding the small camera above the water, slow push-in
24mm wide shot of the small camera drifting away on the brown flood into the rain with the boulder behind, locked off

steps: @Khang reaches up for the dangling rope on top of the boulder as the buckle of his chest harness pops open, and is already shouting, eyes wide.
@Khang keeps shouting as the small chest camera slides off his harness, and his free hand closes around it just above the churning water.
@Khang holds the rope in one fist and the little camera in the other, its red light blinking, still shouting at it.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, frozen between his two hands, breathing fast.
High on the torchlit ledge, @Stream leans over the edge with the upper end of the rope in her hands and starts shouting down fiercely.
@Stream keeps shouting, pointing hard at the boulder below, rain streaming down her face.
@Stream keeps shouting down, wrapping the rope around her own forearm to hold it steady.
@Stream finishes and closes her mouth, braced at the ledge edge, staring down.
@Khang looks at the little camera in his hand, rain beading on its blinking red light, and starts speaking slowly and quietly.
@Khang keeps talking low, his thumb brushing once over the wet camera body, his jaw working.
@Khang keeps speaking softly and opens his fingers; the camera drops into the brown water below the boulder.
@Khang goes on quietly as he takes the rope in both hands, his eyes following the camera on the water.
@Khang says the last words in a low steady voice, both fists tight on the rope.
The small camera drifts away on the churning brown flood into the rain, its red light blinking, as @Khang closes his mouth on the boulder behind.
The blinking red light shrinks into the dark rain while @Khang holds the rope with both hands, mouth closed, watching it go.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: The water came. The lower cave is flooded.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Is everyone here, Grandma? Did Snail keep the fire?
turns.tone: out of breath, lying on the rock

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: All here. The fire lives, the people live. You gave your stone for our fire.
turns.tone: slow and warm, every word weighed

clips.setting: Night during a flash flood in the Stone Age: a narrow ledge-cave high on a limestone cliff lit by flickering torches, heavy rain, and far below a roaring brown flood surging over the stream banks toward the mouth of the lower cave.

wardrobe.@Khang: dirty torn olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera
wardrobe.@Moon: a long dark hide cloak over a knee-length bark-cloth tunic, empty-handed with no bamboo tube, barefoot

clips.sfx: rain easing on the rock ledge, torches hissing, the flood roaring far below, heavy ragged breathing, a bamboo cap popping off, embers crackling softly

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the old clan leader at the edge of the torchlit ledge looking down at the flood, locked off
50mm high-angle close-up of the young man lying on his back on the wet rock, handheld
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the young man onto the old woman kneeling beside him, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the old clan leader in the torch and ember light, slow push-in

steps: @Moon stands at the edge of the torchlit ledge staring down at the roaring brown flood and is already speaking, hushed, her eyes fixed on the water.
@Moon keeps speaking quietly as the brown water churns over the mouth of the lower cave far below.
@Moon's hand tightens on her hide cloak as she says the last words.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, then turns from the edge toward the rope.
@Khang lies flat on his back on the wet rock of the ledge, soaked and muddy, his chest harness empty, and starts asking between gasps.
@Khang keeps talking breathlessly, lifting his head to look around the torchlit ledge.
@Khang pushes himself up on one elbow as he finishes his question, rain running off his face.
@Khang closes his mouth, chest heaving, as @Moon kneels beside him and, behind her, small hands open a bamboo tube glowing with red embers.
@Moon starts speaking slowly and warmly, looking into @Khang's face, the ember glow on her cheek.
@Moon keeps talking in her low husky voice, nodding toward the clan crowding the ledge behind her.
@Moon lays one weathered hand on @Khang's empty chest harness as she goes on.
@Moon keeps speaking slowly, her calm eyes glistening in the torchlight above him.
@Moon says the last words with weight, her hand still resting on his chest.
@Moon keeps speaking slowly to the end, the red ochre dot on her forehead lit by the embers.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, holding his gaze in silence as rain drips from the rock overhead.
clips.extras: the clan in bark-cloth tunics and hide wraps crowds the torchlit ledge behind them in soft focus, shoulders sagging as they breathe out

scenes.title: Day Seven: The First Hand (Ngày 7: Bàn tay đầu tiên)
scenes.location: Bình minh trong vắt sau lũ: thung lũng ngập bùn, cây đổ ngổn ngang. Hang dưới đã rút nước, vách đá ướt và vẫn trơn. Một phiến đá dùng để nghiền đất son đỏ.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt trong lòng hang dưới nhìn ra cửa hang sáng: vách đá trơn ẩm ở bên trái, nhũ đá hình con voi ở giữa hậu cảnh, phiến đá nghiền son ở bên phải, cửa hang rộng ngập nắng sớm ở xa nhất; riêng 19.1 máy đứng trên mỏm hang trên, sau lưng cả hang, nhìn xuống thung lũng bùn phía trước.
scenes.props: Phiến đá nghiền dẹt với bột son đỏ, vỏ ốc to đựng nước, ống sậy rỗng, ống tre giữ lửa của Grandma Moon, đai đeo ngực trống không camera của Khang, bàn tay son đỏ đầu tiên ở giữa vách.
scenes.setting: The lower Stone Age cave the morning after the flood: wet mud on the floor, the elephant-shaped stalactite, the bare damp rock wall in soft daylight, a flat grinding stone with red-ochre powder and a hollow reed tube.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Seventh sun. You lived, and you saved the cave.
turns.tone: slow and grave, like a law spoken aloud

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Not alone. Stream fed me, Roar held the rope, Snail kept the fire.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Then you are of the cave. We never walk alone.
turns.tone: warm and final, a rare small smile

clips.sfx: dawn birdsong across the valley, water dripping off the cliff, a soft wind on the ledge, the stream trickling far below, bare feet shifting on stone

shots.camera: 24mm wide shot along the cliff ledge over the mud-covered valley, the old woman in the foreground turning to camera, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the survivalist in the low dawn sun, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the survivalist onto the old woman, locked off
35mm medium two-shot in profile at the ledge edge, the misty valley glowing below, slow drift

steps: On the sunlit ledge above the mud-covered valley, @Moon turns from the edge toward @Khang, the bamboo ember tube in her arms, and is already speaking slowly.
@Moon keeps speaking, each word weighed, the dawn sun lighting the deep lines of her face and the red dot on her forehead.
@Moon lifts her chin toward the drowned valley behind her as she goes on, while @Khang listens with his mouth closed.
@Moon keeps talking slowly, her calm eyes resting on the empty chest harness strapped over his torn shirt.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth; @Khang shakes his head with a tired smile, draws a breath and starts answering.
@Khang keeps talking warmly, his stubble grown into a short dark beard, counting names on the fingers of one blistered hand.
@Khang keeps speaking, tipping his head toward the clan standing along the ledge behind him.
@Khang goes on, his voice catching slightly, his eyes shining in the low gold light.
@Khang keeps talking, pressing one blistered palm flat against his chest over the empty harness.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, looking down at his muddy boots, while @Moon draws a breath beside him.
@Moon steps closer, lays one small wrinkled hand on his forearm and answers, her low voice softening.
@Moon keeps speaking, holding his gaze, the bamboo ember tube tucked against her hide cloak.
@Moon keeps going, nodding once toward the clan along the ledge as she says the last words.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, a rare small smile creasing her lined face.
@Khang bows his head to her, mouth closed, while mist curls off the drowned valley below them in the dawn sun.
clips.extras: a dozen clan members in bark-cloth tunics and hide wraps stand along the ledge looking down at the valley, seen from behind in soft focus
clips.setting: Clear golden dawn after the flood, seen from a ledge-cave high on the limestone cliff: the valley below covered in mud and fallen trees, the stream back in its bed, mist rising off the jungle.

wardrobe.@Khang: dirty torn olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: From today, whoever saves the cave leaves a hand on the wall.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Red earth and water, blown through a reed. Fire first?
turns.tone: curious and eager, turning the reed

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Yes. His hand is biggest. Put it in the middle.

clips.sfx: stone grinding on stone, water dripping from the cave roof, runoff trickling across the mud floor, birdsong outside the bright mouth

steps: In the damp lower cave, @Moon kneels at a flat grinding stone, rolling a pebble through red-ochre powder, and is already speaking in a steady voice.
@Moon keeps speaking as she tips water from a large snail shell onto the powder, turning it into a red paste.
@Moon keeps going, lifting her red-stained fingers toward the bare wet wall beside her.
@Moon keeps talking, her eyes moving slowly across the empty rock, while @Stream watches with her mouth closed.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, wiping her red fingertips on the edge of the grinding stone.
@Stream steps in holding a hollow reed tube, tilts her head and starts speaking eagerly.
@Stream keeps talking, turning the hollow reed between her fingers and peering through it at the daylight.
@Stream keeps speaking, glancing from the red paste to the bare wall with bright eyes.
@Stream asks her last question with her eyebrows raised, then closes her mouth and waits.
@Moon looks up at her and answers slowly, setting the pebble down on the grinding stone.
@Moon keeps speaking, holding up one wrinkled hand and spreading the fingers wide.
@Moon keeps going slowly, pointing one red-stained finger at the very middle of the bare wall.
@Moon keeps talking as both women turn their faces toward the empty rock in the soft daylight.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, nodding once, while @Stream breathes in and grips the reed tighter.
@Stream carries a small shell cup of red paste toward the wall, mouth closed, while @Moon watches in silence.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: The big hand in the middle... it's mine. Always was.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: What's wrong, Fire? No rain will ever wash it away.
turns.tone: gentle, puzzled, proud of her work

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: No. Ten thousand years from now, some idiot will fit his hand in it.

clips.sfx: soft puffs of air through a hollow reed, a fine spray hissing on wet stone, water dripping in the cave, morning birdsong outside

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot at the bare wall, his palm flat in the middle of the rock as she puffs red mist through a reed, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the young forager lowering the reed, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the young forager onto the survivalist and the fresh red hand, locked off
35mm medium two-shot at the wall, the fresh red hand between them, slow push-in

steps: At the bare wall, @Khang holds his palm flat in the middle of the rock while @Stream puffs red mist around his fingers, and he is already whispering.
@Khang keeps whispering, staring at the red outline forming around his spread fingers on the wet stone.
@Khang keeps whispering, his breath shaking, while @Stream moves the reed slowly along his thumb in soft red puffs.
@Khang goes on in a hushed voice, his eyes wide and wet above his short beard, never leaving his own hand.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and slowly peels his palm off the rock, leaving a bright red hand outline, as @Stream lowers the reed.
@Stream asks gently, red dust on her lips, searching his face with her bright dark eyes.
@Stream keeps speaking, nodding at the red hand on the wall with a small proud smile.
@Stream goes on warmly, touching the dry rock just beside the stencil with one fingertip.
@Stream finishes and closes her mouth, waiting, while @Khang stares at the wall, his jaw trembling.
@Khang lets out a shaky laugh, tears brimming, and starts answering, his voice cracking.
@Khang keeps talking, wiping his eyes with the back of his wrist, laughing and crying at once.
@Khang keeps speaking, holding up his red-dusted palm beside the red hand on the wall.
@Khang goes on, shaking his head at himself, tears running down into his beard.
@Khang finishes the last words with a broken grin, his eyes on the stencil.
@Khang closes his mouth and breathes out shakily beside the fresh red hand, while @Stream watches him in silence.

wardrobe.@Khang: dirty torn olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: My hand next to yours. So everyone knows they went together.
turns.tone: soft and shy, eyes on the wall

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Stream... if I have to leave, will you be angry?

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: A stream goes far but marks the stone. If you go, your hand stays.

clips.sfx: soft puffs of air through a reed, a fine spray hissing on stone, water dripping in the cave, morning birdsong outside, a slow breath

steps: @Stream steps up beside @Khang, presses her small hand flat on the rock right next to his red stencil, and is already speaking softly.
@Stream keeps talking, spreading her fingers wide on the damp stone, her eyes on the two hands.
@Stream keeps speaking, a shy smile tugging at her mouth, while @Khang watches her with his mouth closed.
@Stream goes on, lifting the hollow reed toward her chin with her free hand.
@Stream finishes and closes her mouth, puts the reed to her lips, and @Khang turns toward her, swallowing.
@Khang asks slowly and quietly, his eyes on her face, while soft red mist puffs out of focus beside him.
@Khang keeps speaking haltingly, his voice low, his bearded jaw tight, his eyes never leaving her.
@Khang goes on, glancing toward the daylight at the cave mouth and back to her.
@Khang finishes his question, closes his mouth and waits, breathing slowly, the empty harness rising and falling on his chest.
@Stream lowers the reed and peels her hand off the rock, two red hands now side by side, and answers without looking at him.
@Stream keeps speaking, her eyes fixed on the wall, red dust on her fingertips.
@Stream keeps talking evenly, touching the edge of her own red hand with one finger.
@Stream goes on, her chin lifting, blinking fast, still not looking at him.
@Stream keeps speaking steadily, a single tear sliding down past the red stripes on her cheek.
@Stream finishes the last words and closes her mouth, gazing at the two red hands side by side, while @Khang watches her in silence.

scenes.title: Snail's Seeing Stone (Hòn đá có mắt của Snail)
scenes.location: Bãi suối sau lũ đã trong lại, nắng trưa; trong hang dưới, vách có hai bàn tay đỏ; chiều xuống, mây giông kéo về đầu núi.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đứng trên bãi sỏi nhìn ngược dòng: suối trong ở bên trái, tảng đá Khang ngồi ở giữa, bó cỏ làm bia ở xa bên phải, vách đá vôi và rừng ở hậu cảnh; 20.3 quay sát vách hang có hai bàn tay đỏ ở bên trái và bếp lửa bên phải, 20.4 đứng ở cửa hang nhìn ra núi với vách có hai bàn tay ở bên trái.
scenes.props: Phiến đá dẹt có lỗ thủng của Snail, giáo tre mũi đá, bó cỏ làm bia, cái lờ tre Roar đan dở, gậy chống và nẹp chân quấn khăn rằn đỏ của Roar, cục than, hai bàn tay son đỏ trên vách.
scenes.setting: The jungle stream in the Stone Age at midday after the flood: the water clear again, a gravel bar with drying driftwood, a bundle of grass set up as a target, children of the clan playing on the stones.

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: Hello everyone! Fire, fish, boiled water! I can survive anywhere!
turns.tone: bursting with excitement, a tiny showman

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Who taught you that? That line was a lie for three years.

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: You say it to your stone every morning! Now I have one!

clips.sfx: the clear stream rippling over stones, small bare feet splashing in the shallows, cicadas in the midday heat, driftwood creaking in the sun
