steps: On a sunny river stone, @Snail holds a flat stone with a hole in it up to his face like a camera and is already shouting excitedly into it.
@Snail keeps talking fast, swinging the stone toward the clear stream and back to his own grinning face.
@Snail keeps going, flexing one skinny arm for the stone, while the children around him bounce on their heels.
@Snail finishes with a big proud grin and closes his mouth; on a boulder nearby, @Khang bursts out laughing and starts to answer.
@Khang laughs and asks, shaking his head, his muddy elbows propped on his knees.
@Khang keeps talking, wiping a tear of laughter from his eye with his wrist.
@Khang goes on, his grin softening into something rueful, pointing at the boy.
@Khang keeps speaking, tapping the empty chest harness on his torn shirt with two fingers.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, still smiling, as @Snail spins around to face him.
@Snail answers fast, jabbing the flat stone toward @Khang, his big eyes shining.
@Snail keeps talking quickly, holding the stone up proudly to show off the hole.
@Snail keeps going, pressing one eye to the hole as if filming @Khang.
@Snail finishes, closes his mouth and grins through the hole in the stone.
@Khang shakes with silent laughter, lips pressed together, and raises both hands in surrender as the children crowd closer.
@Snail turns the stone toward the children on the gravel bar, mouth closed, while @Khang watches him fondly from the boulder.
clips.extras: a few small clan children in knee-length bark-cloth tunics crouch on the river stones around the boy, grinning, in soft focus

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Eyes closed, you only hit sky. Eyes open, see the target, let go.
turns.tone: gruff and teasing, laughing for once

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: You learned traps in one morning. I still can't hit anything!

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Your hands make fire and traps. Leave the spear to me, brother.

steps: On the sunny gravel bar, @Roar sits on a flat rock with his splinted ankle stretched out, weaving a fish trap, and is already speaking with a gruff grin.
@Roar keeps talking, squeezing his eyes shut in mockery and flapping one big hand at the sky.
@Roar opens his eyes wide and keeps speaking, pointing two fingers from his eyes toward the grass bundle downstream.
@Roar keeps going, miming a slow release with his open hand, while @Khang lifts the bamboo spear upright beside him, mouth closed.
@Roar says the last words as @Khang walks out onto the empty gravel, sets his feet and raises the spear toward the grass bundle.
@Roar closes his mouth as @Khang sends the spear arcing toward the grass bundle; it skids into the gravel far wide of it, and he starts complaining fast.
@Khang keeps talking fast, both palms up at the untouched grass bundle, sweat running into his short beard.
@Khang keeps going, pointing at the neat half-woven fish trap on @Roar's lap, his eyebrows high.
@Khang keeps talking, shaking his head at his own blistered palms with a crooked laugh.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and drops to sit on the gravel beside @Roar's rock, as @Roar starts answering.
@Roar keeps speaking in his deep voice, tapping @Khang's blistered palm with one thick finger.
@Roar keeps talking, lifting the half-woven fish trap and turning it in the sun.
@Roar goes on, laying one heavy hand on @Khang's shoulder, his fierce eyes softening.
@Roar keeps speaking, leaning closer, his gruff voice dropping warm on the final word.
@Roar closes his mouth and a slow wide grin breaks across his fierce face, his shoulders shaking with a silent laugh.

scenes.time_label: Một tuần sau, hiên nhà nghỉ (22:00–23:00)
scenes.location: Hiên nhà sàn gỗ của nhà nghỉ ven rừng, chiều; Khang đã cạo râu, cổ đeo chuỗi vỏ ốc; trước mặt chỉ có điện thoại của Bin trên chân máy, không đèn, không đạo cụ.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt trên sàn hiên nhìn ngang: Khang ngồi trên bậc hiên ở giữa, chân máy nhỏ với điện thoại ở bên trái, Bin ngồi sau chân máy lùi về bên trái, cửa nhà sàn bên phải, dãy núi đá vôi trong nắng chiều ở xa nhất.
scenes.props: Điện thoại trên chân máy nhỏ (màn hình chỉ phát sáng), chuỗi vỏ ốc suối trên cổ Khang, ống tre tươi, thanh tre khía rãnh, cái còi, nan tre và cái lờ nhỏ đan dở, chậu cây.
scenes.setting: The wooden porch of a stilt-house guesthouse at the forest edge today in late afternoon: worn plank steps, potted plants, a smartphone on a small tripod, limestone peaks glowing in the distance.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Today, no old opening line. I can survive anywhere: I lied about that for three years.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: You sure? Say that, and the last sponsors walk.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Sure. Let them. Faking it makes you starve.

clips.sfx: cicadas at the forest edge, a rooster far off, wooden porch boards creaking, leaves rustling in a light breeze

85mm close-up of the survivalist looking straight into the lens, slow push-in
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the survivalist onto the cameraman leaning out from behind the tripod

steps: On the sunlit porch step, @Khang sits facing a smartphone on a small tripod and is already speaking plainly into its lens.
@Khang keeps speaking evenly, the shell necklace resting on his plain grey T-shirt, his hands loose on his knees.
@Khang goes on, a wry twist at the corner of his mouth as he shakes his head once.
@Khang keeps talking, looking straight into the lens without a showman's grin.
@Khang keeps speaking steadily, rubbing the faint blister scars on one palm with his thumb.
@Khang keeps going, his jaw set, holding the lens with his eyes.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth; behind the tripod, @Bin leans out sideways and starts asking softly.
@Bin keeps speaking in a low voice, glancing at the blank glowing phone screen and back at @Khang.
@Bin keeps going quietly, eyebrows lifted above his round glasses, one hand on the tripod leg.
@Bin finishes and closes his mouth, waiting, his lips pressed together, his eyes flicking to the phone.
@Khang turns back to the lens and answers slowly, without a trace of hesitation.
@Khang keeps speaking, a small calm shrug lifting his shoulders, his eyes never leaving the lens.
@Khang goes on, touching one shell of the necklace at his collar.
@Khang finishes the last words and closes his mouth, his eyes steady on the lens.
@Khang sits still on the porch step, mouth closed, the limestone peaks glowing behind him in the late sun.

wardrobe.@Khang: plain grey cotton T-shirt, khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a necklace of small stream-snail shells

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Most of my old videos were staged. You trusted me, and I'm sorry.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Here's what's real, learned with blistered hands: boil your water, green bamboo can boil it, bamboo can make fire, three whistle blasts means help.
turns.tone: brisk and practical, teaching for real

clips.sfx: porch boards creaking, bamboo knocking softly on wood, cicadas at the forest edge, a light breeze through the potted plants

steps: @Khang keeps his eyes on the phone lens and is already speaking, his voice low and steady, the shell necklace at his collar.
@Khang keeps speaking honestly, his gaze dropping for a moment to his hands.
@Khang goes on, lifting his eyes back to the lens, his jaw tight.
@Khang keeps talking, pressing one palm flat against his chest in apology.
@Khang says the last words of the apology, then takes one slow breath.
@Khang closes his mouth briefly, picks up a fresh green bamboo tube from the porch boards and starts talking fast.
@Khang keeps talking quickly, holding the green bamboo tube up to the lens and tapping its node.
@Khang keeps going, setting the tube down and lifting a split bamboo strip with a notched groove.
@Khang keeps talking fast, sawing his fingertip across the notch to show the motion.
@Khang keeps speaking, showing the faint blister scars across his palm beside the bamboo.
@Khang keeps going, setting the bamboo down and holding up a small plastic whistle.
@Khang keeps talking quickly, raising three fingers beside the whistle and nodding firmly at the lens.
@Khang finishes the last words and closes his mouth, the whistle still raised.
@Khang lowers the whistle into his open palm, mouth closed, looking calmly at the lens.
The whistle rests in @Khang's open palm, faint blister scars catching the late golden sun, all quiet but the cicadas.

wardrobe.@Khang: plain grey cotton T-shirt, khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a necklace of small stream-snail shells

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Khang, three hours, five million views! Nobody's hating on you. People are actually thanking you!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Huh. So people watch the truth too.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: And half the comments ask where you bought that shell necklace.

clips.sfx: a screen door banging, quick footsteps on porch boards, bamboo strips rustling, cicadas, a rooster far away

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot following the cameraman out onto the porch with a glowing phone, handheld

steps: @Bin bursts out through the doorway onto the porch, holding up his phone with its blank screen glowing, and is already talking fast.
@Bin keeps talking rapidly, his eyes huge behind his round glasses, his thumb scrolling the glowing screen.
@Bin keeps going, thrusting the glowing phone toward @Khang, almost tripping on the porch step.
@Bin keeps talking fast, half laughing, pressing one hand to the top of his bucket hat.
@Bin finishes and closes his mouth, panting, holding the phone out at arm's length.
@Khang, sitting on the step weaving a small fish trap from bamboo strips, answers without looking up.
@Khang keeps speaking evenly, threading one thin strip through the woven rim.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, a faint smile at one corner, his eyes on the trap.
@Bin crouches beside him, lowers the phone and goes on, a curious grin spreading.
@Bin keeps talking, pointing at the shell necklace on @Khang's chest, his eyes twinkling behind his glasses.
@Bin keeps going, scrolling the glowing screen with his thumb, eyebrows high.
@Bin keeps speaking, leaning in close to study the small shells, his nose almost touching them.
@Bin finishes and closes his mouth, waiting with an expectant look, his phone dangling from one hand.
@Khang's fingers stop on the bamboo strips, mouth closed, as he glances down at the necklace.
@Khang and @Bin sit side by side on the porch step in the golden light, both silent, the limestone peaks glowing far behind.

wardrobe.@Khang: plain grey cotton T-shirt, khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a necklace of small stream-snail shells

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: You can't buy it. Someone put it on me, somewhere very far away.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Who? Seven days in the jungle and you got a girlfriend? Tell me!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: You won't believe me. Take me to the cave tomorrow.

clips.sfx: bamboo strips creaking, cicadas, a breeze through the potted plants, small shells clicking, a rooster far away

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot on the porch step, holding the previous framing
85mm close-up of the survivalist holding a small shell up to the late sun, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the survivalist onto the cameraman, locked off
85mm close-up of the survivalist smiling, the limestone peaks soft behind him, slow push-in

steps: @Khang sets the half-woven trap aside, lifts the shell necklace off his chest and is already speaking slowly, his eyes on the shells.
@Khang keeps speaking softly, turning one small stream-snail shell to the late golden light.
@Khang goes on, a far-away look in his eyes, while @Bin watches him with his mouth closed.
@Khang keeps speaking quietly, his thumb tracing the spiral of the shell.
@Khang keeps talking slowly, glancing out toward the distant limestone peaks glowing in the late afternoon sun.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, letting the shell fall back against his T-shirt.
@Bin scoots closer beside him and starts talking fast, his eyes wide with curiosity.
@Bin keeps talking rapidly, nudging @Khang's shoulder with his own, grinning from ear to ear.
@Bin keeps going, wagging a finger at the necklace, his eyebrows bouncing above his glasses.
@Bin finishes his demand and closes his mouth, leaning in with his chin propped on one fist, waiting.
@Khang smiles to himself, shakes his head slowly and answers in a calm, unhurried voice.
@Khang keeps speaking, picking up the half-woven fish trap again and threading one bamboo strip.
@Khang goes on, turning to look at @Bin with a quiet, knowing smile.
@Khang finishes the last words and closes his mouth, his smile lingering.
@Khang goes back to weaving the bamboo strips, mouth closed, as the limestone peaks glow in the late sun.

wardrobe.@Khang: plain grey cotton T-shirt, khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a necklace of small stream-snail shells

scenes.title: Fire-Maker (Người làm ra lửa)
scenes.time_label: Sáng, hang Bàn Tay ngày nay và hơn một vạn năm trước (23:00–24:00)
scenes.location: Hang Bàn Tay hôm nay, nắng sớm rọi xiên vào cửa hang. Clip cuối cắt song song với cùng hang ấy hơn một vạn năm trước, bên bếp lửa.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt trong lòng hang nhìn ra cửa hang ngập nắng: vách hàng trăm bàn tay đỏ mờ ở bên trái với bàn tay to ở giữa, bàn tay nhỏ và hình người que bằng than sát bên, nhũ đá hình con voi ở giữa hậu cảnh, cửa hang vòm rộng ở xa bên phải; riêng 24.4 cắt song song cùng góc máy ấy giữa buổi sáng hôm nay và đêm bên bếp lửa hơn một vạn năm trước.
scenes.props: Đèn pin và điện thoại của Bin (màn hình chỉ phát sáng), chuỗi vỏ ốc suối trên cổ Khang, hai bàn tay son đỏ và hình người que đeo hộp vuông bằng than trên vách; ở thời xưa: hòn đá dẹt có lỗ của Snail, bếp lửa, ống tre chẻ đôi và thanh tre cưa lửa.
scenes.setting: Morning inside the same large limestone cave today: sunlight slanting through the wide arched mouth onto the elephant-shaped stalactite and the wall of hundreds of faded red-ochre hand stencils, the bigger hand in the middle with a smaller hand beside it and a faint charcoal stick figure wearing a square box on its chest.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Look! By the big hand: a stick man with a box on his chest. Like your camera!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: A little boy drew it. So the seeing stone wouldn't be sad.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Archaeologists say it's over ten thousand years old!

clips.sfx: a flashlight click, sneakers scuffing on grit, water dripping, birdsong and cicadas outside the sunlit mouth

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the cameraman sweeping his flashlight across the wall of faded red hands, handheld
85mm close-up of the cameraman's face beside the faint charcoal stick figure in the flashlight beam, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the cameraman onto the survivalist, slow push-in
35mm medium two-shot at the wall, the big red hand and the charcoal figure between them, locked off

steps: In the shadowed back of the sunlit cave, @Bin sweeps his flashlight over the wall of faded red hands and is already talking fast, pointing.
@Bin keeps talking excitedly, stepping closer to the big faded hand in the middle of the wall.
@Bin keeps going, holding the beam on a faint charcoal stick figure right beside the big hand.
@Bin keeps talking fast, tracing in the air the little square box with rays on the figure's chest.
@Bin keeps going, tapping his own chest where a camera harness would sit, his eyes wide behind his glasses.
@Bin finishes and closes his mouth, turning to @Khang with his eyebrows shooting up, lips pressed together.
@Khang steps up beside him, gazing at the charcoal figure, and answers slowly with a soft smile.
@Khang keeps speaking gently, touching the stream-snail shells at his collar, his eyes on the drawing.
@Khang goes on, his eyes warm and wet in the slanting sunlight.
@Khang keeps speaking softly, nodding at the little drawing as if greeting an old friend.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, still smiling at the faint charcoal figure on the wall.
@Bin swings the flashlight back to the drawing and blurts out fast, his eyes huge.
@Bin keeps talking rapidly, glancing between the charcoal figure and @Khang's face.
@Bin finishes and closes his mouth, his flashlight beam trembling on the rock.
@Bin stares at the faint charcoal stick figure, mouth closed, while @Khang smiles beside him in silence.

wardrobe.@Khang: plain grey cotton T-shirt, khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a necklace of small stream-snail shells

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: And this smaller hand, right beside it. That's a girl named Stream.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: You're acting again, right? Good script, but I'm not buying it.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: You don't have to. No filming, no posting. Remembering is enough.

clips.sfx: water dripping from the stalactite, distant birdsong outside, a flashlight buzzing faintly, small shells clicking

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot at the wall, holding the previous framing, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the cameraman squinting behind his round glasses, locked off

steps: @Khang reaches out and rests his fingertips on the smaller faded hand right beside the big one, and is already speaking slowly.
@Khang keeps speaking softly, his fingertips tracing the faded red outline of the small fingers.
@Khang goes on, a tender look in his eyes, while @Bin watches him with his mouth closed.
@Khang keeps talking quietly, his other hand closing around the shells of his necklace.
@Khang keeps speaking slowly, his voice dropping almost to a whisper, his fingertips still on the rock.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth; @Bin narrows his eyes behind his round glasses and starts answering.
@Bin keeps talking in a dry, knowing voice, wagging the flashlight at @Khang.
@Bin keeps going, squinting from the faded wall to @Khang and back, his head tilted skeptically.
@Bin keeps speaking, folding his arms with a skeptical half-smile, the flashlight tucked under one elbow.
@Bin finishes and closes his mouth, one eyebrow raised high above his round glasses, waiting.
@Khang answers calmly over his shoulder, his fingertips still resting on the small red hand.
@Khang keeps speaking, shaking his head gently, with no showman's grin, just a quiet calm.
@Khang goes on, lifting his hand away from the rock and laying it on his chest.
@Khang keeps speaking softly, his eyes steady and clear, a faint smile at the corners of his mouth.
@Khang finishes the last words and closes his mouth, gazing at the two faded hands side by side.

wardrobe.@Khang: plain grey cotton T-shirt, khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a necklace of small stream-snail shells

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Whoa! Thunder! Take your hand off! Last time you touched that, you vanished for seven days!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Scared I'll vanish? Over there, they have fire now. They don't need me.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Over where? Explain that to me right now!

clips.sfx: a long low roll of distant thunder, sneakers scuffing on grit, a flashlight knocking against stone, birdsong falling quiet outside

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot at the wall, his palm inside the big red hand, handheld
85mm close-up of the survivalist laughing, locked off

24mm wide shot from deep in the cave toward the bright arched mouth, slow pull-back

steps: Distant thunder rolls outside as @Khang rests his palm inside the big faded red hand, a perfect fit, and @Bin jolts and is already shouting.
@Bin keeps shouting fast, flapping both hands at @Khang's arm, his flashlight beam swinging wildly.
@Bin takes hold of @Khang's forearm with both hands, still talking fast, and tugs it away from the wall.
@Bin keeps going breathlessly, his eyes darting to the bright cave mouth as the thunder rumbles again.
@Bin keeps talking rapidly, pulling @Khang a step back from the wall of hands.
@Bin finishes and closes his mouth, panting; @Khang bursts out laughing and starts answering.
@Khang keeps talking through his laughter, his free hand on @Bin's shoulder.
@Khang keeps speaking, his laugh settling into a warm grin as he glances at the wall.
@Khang goes on, nodding toward the big red hand with quiet certainty.
@Khang keeps speaking gently, the shell necklace swinging at his chest as he turns back to @Bin.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, still smiling, while @Bin stares at him, blinking.
@Bin flings both hands up and fires back fast, his glasses askew.
@Bin keeps going, jabbing a finger at @Khang's chest, demanding an answer, his voice cracking high.
@Bin finishes and closes his mouth, glaring at @Khang through his crooked glasses, his chest heaving.
@Khang grins and walks toward the sunlit cave mouth, mouth closed, while @Bin hurries after him, both silent.

wardrobe.@Khang: plain grey cotton T-shirt, khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a necklace of small stream-snail shells

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: I can't survive anywhere. I survived because someone shared their snails with me, and someone held my rope.
turns.tone: slow, plain and grateful, no performance

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: Hello everyone! Today I teach the cave bamboo fire, like Fire taught me! I can survive anywhere!

clips.sfx: birdsong and a soft morning breeze at the cave mouth, then a crackling hearth fire at night, bamboo rasping on bamboo, small bare feet on stone

steps: In the sunlit mouth of the cave today, @Khang faces a phone held up by an unseen hand and is already speaking slowly and plainly.
@Khang keeps speaking, today's morning light on his face, the green limestone jungle bright behind him.
@Khang goes on quietly, his eyes steady on the phone, with no showman's grin.
@Khang keeps speaking, lifting one hand to rest his fingers on the stream-snail shells at his collar.
@Khang keeps talking slowly, rolling one small shell between his fingers, his eyes shining.
@Khang goes on, glancing back over his shoulder toward the faded wall of red hands deep in today's cave.
@Khang keeps speaking, his voice catching slightly, a small grateful smile forming.
@Khang finishes the last words and closes his mouth, breathing out, the sun warm on his face.
More than ten thousand years ago at night, @Snail stands by the hearth fire, raises his flat stone with a hole to his face and starts shouting brightly.
Long ago at night, @Snail keeps talking fast, beaming, pointing the flat stone at the clan seated around the fire.
Long ago by the hearth, @Snail keeps going, lifting a split bamboo tube and a notched bamboo strip from the ground.
Long ago at night, @Snail keeps shouting with joy, sawing the strip across the bamboo once to show the seated clan.
Long ago by the firelight, @Snail keeps talking, thrusting the flat stone high, his snail-shell bracelet rattling on his wrist.
Long ago at night, firelight flickers over the two fresh red hands side by side on the rock wall, one big and one smaller, as the boy falls silent.
Today, soft morning sunlight replaces the firelight on the very same two hands, now faded with age, still side by side.
clips.extras: in the night shots long ago only, the Stone Age clan in bark-cloth tunics and hide wraps sits around the hearth watching the boy, in soft focus
clips.setting: The same limestone cave mouth with the elephant-shaped stalactite in two times: today in bright morning sun with the wall of faded red hand stencils, and more than ten thousand years ago at night, lit by a hearth fire with the clan sitting around it and two fresh red hand stencils on the wall.
